sa: कच्चिन्न चानुदृश्यन्ते कपयः कामरूपिणः। अथैवमुक्ते वचने हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having been addressed with those words, Hanumăn replied, communicating to Bharata, having truth for his prowess, the truth.

sa: विभीषणमुखानां च सुहृदां राघवाज्ञया। सर्ववानरमुख्यानां चिकित्सासमकरोत्तदा ॥
en: At the mandate of Rāghava he likewise treated his friends headed by Vibhișaņa and all the principal monkeys.

sa: तदप्रियं दीनमुखा रावणस्य च राक्षसाः। कृत्स्नं निवेदयामासुर्यथावद्वाक्यकोविदाः॥
en: Then with woe-begone faces, those Raksasas, skilled in speech, faithfully informed Rāvana in full of that unfortunate circumstance.

sa: हर्षेणापूर्यमाणोऽसौ रम्ये पर्वतनिझरे। छिन्नपक्ष इवाकाशात् पपात धरणीधरः॥
en: And bursting with delight, (Hanumān) dropped near a fountain, like to a hill whose wings have been clipped.

sa: रावणावरजे वाक्यमेवं ब्रुवति राघवः। शत्रूणां प्रतिघातार्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: When Rāvana's younger brother had spoken thus, Rāghava, said these words with reference to his beating the foe.

sa: अन्योन्यं च समाश्लिष्य हरयो हृष्टमानसाः। चनुरुच्चावचगुणा राघवाश्रयसत्कथाः॥
en: And embracing each other, the monkeys with delighted spirits began to converse in various ways touching Raghava's welfare.

sa: शरजालाचितौ वीरावुभौ दशरथात्मजौ। शरतल्ये महात्मानौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ॥
en: And (did you not see) those high-should ones lying in the field of battle, covered with blood ?

sa: कपिराजविमुक्तैस्तैः शैलवस्तु राक्षसाः। विकर्णशिरस: पेतुर्विकीर्णा इव पर्वताः॥
en: Being beheaded by the crags discharged by that monkeys chief the Rākşasas fell down like to mountains cleft.

sa: घोररूपाः शिवा नेदुः सज्वालकवलैर्मुखैः। मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि बबन्धुश्च विहंगमाः॥
en: And fierce jackals began to cry, opening their fiaming mouths. And birds began to wheel at the left.

sa: राज्यं दशसहस्राणि प्राप्य वर्षाणि राघवः। दशाश्वमेधानाजह्वे सदश्वान्भूरिदक्षिणान्॥
en: And governing the kingdom for ten thousand years Rāghava performed ten horse-sacrifices with excellent horses and profuse presents.

sa: ततो भेरी: समाजघ्नुर्मृदङ्गाश्चाप्यवादयन्। दध्मुः शङ्खान्संप्रहृष्टा श्वेलन्त्यपि यथापुरम्॥
en: Then beat the kettle-drums and the drums struck up. And conchs were cheerfully blown; and shouts were sent.

sa: कृतदारास्तु ते राम सुकेशतनयास्तदा॥ चिक्रीडुः सह भाभिरप्सरोभिरिवामराः।
en: And having wedded, O Rama, Sukesa's sons began to sport with their wives, like celestials sporting with Apsarās.

sa: गिरिवरमभितो विवर्तमानो हय इव मण्डलमाशु यः करोति। तमिह शरणमभ्युपैहि देवि दिवसकरं प्रभवो ह्ययं प्रजानाम्॥
en: Do you, O exalted one, take refuge with him, who, going round the foremost of mountains, speedily assume a steed-like circular movement; for even the maker of day is the source of people's joy and grief.

sa: राजहंसप्रतीकाशं छत्रं पूर्णशशिप्रभम्। सौवर्णदण्डमपरा गृहीत्वा पृष्ठतो ययौ॥
en: Another carrying the white umbrella having golden ribs resembling the full moon and goose, followed in the train.

sa: तत्रोपविष्टं राजानमुपासन्ते विचक्षणाः। कथानां बहुरूपाणां हास्यकाराः समन्ततः॥
en: Rāma having taken his seat there, the experienced councillors encircling him began to dwell upon many amusing stories.

sa: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपुरःसराः। महेन्द्राग्रात् समुत्पत्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः॥
en: And these leading monkeys headed by the Wind-god's son proceeded leading from the summit of the Mount Mahendra.

sa: ततः कैलासमासाद्य शैलं वैश्रवणालयम्। राक्षसेन्द्रो महेन्द्राभः सेनामुपनिवेशयत्॥
en: Thereupon reaching the hill Kailāsa, the abode of Vaisravana, the lord of Raksasas, resembling Mahendra, encamped his army.

sa: देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च नागकन्याश्च वीर्यवान्। अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् नैवापश्यत जानकीम्॥
en: Hanumān endowed with prowess saw the daughters of gods, and Yaksa, and Nagas; but he saw not Jānaki.

sa: ततो निकुम्भिला नाम लङ्कोपवनमुत्तमम्। तद्राक्षसेन्द्रो बलवान्प्रविवेश सहानुगः॥
en: Thereupon that highly powerful lord of Rāksasas with his followers entered an excellent garden in Larkā named Nikumbhilā.

sa: तस्य वाक्यस्य वाक्यान्ते वानराः कामरूपिणः। ऋक्षराक्षससङ्घाश्च समापेतुरनेकशः॥
en: Immediately after Råma had said this, monkeys assuming shapes at will bears and Rākşasas, began to assemble there.

sa: एतन्मे भगवन्सर्वं हनूमति महामुने। विस्तरेण यथातत्त्वं कथयामरपूजित॥
en: O you worshipped of the immortals, do you truly describe to me in detail this action of Hanuman.

sa: चतुर्दशसहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। हतान्येकेन रामेण मानुषेण पदातिनः॥
en: Fourteen thousand Rākṣasas of dreadful deeds were slain by Rāma single, a human being, fighting, (moreover) on foot.

sa: शीघ्रमेव हि राक्षस्यो विरूपा घोरदर्शनाः। दर्पमस्यापनेष्यन्तु मांसशोणितभोजनाः॥
en: You frightful Rākşasīs terrible to behold, subsisting on flesh and gore, do you at once crush her pride.

sa: हंसकारण्डवोपेताश्चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः। आपगा इव ता रेजूर्जघनैः पुलिनैरिव ॥
en: And those ladies resembled rivers having hips for banks; containing swans and Karandavas, and beautified with ruddy geese.

sa: गत्वा चैवं महाबाहुर्नातिदूरे महायशाः॥ धर्मात्मा नागधन्वानं तीर्थमागमदच्युतः।
en: The mighty-armed and illustrious Rama, of pure soul and unmitigated glory, then proceeded to the tirtha called Nagadhanvana.

sa: पुत्र उवाच किं नु ते मामपश्यन्त्याः पृथिव्या अपि सर्वया। किमाभरणकृत्यं ते किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा॥
en: The son said If you do not behold me, what is this entire earth to you; what will your ornaments do for you, and what is the use of enjoyments and what even of life itself.

sa: अनित्यं हि स्थितो यस्मात् तस्मादतिथिरुच्यते। आचार्यस्य पितुश्चैव सख्युराप्तस्य चातिथेः॥ इदमस्ति गृहे मह्यमिति नित्यं निवेदयेत्।
en: To his preceptor, to his father, to his friend and to a guest, a householder should say, I have got this in my house to offer you today! And he should offer it accordingly every day.

sa: तथैव च महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो निशाचरः। शक्रं कार्मुकविभ्रष्टैः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: And the Rākşasa-chief Daśānana, having long arms, also assailed Indra with hundreds of shafts discharged off his bow.

sa: तं बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्षः पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम ह। लक्ष्मणः परमक्रुद्धः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः॥
en: Then followed him Lakşmaņa, the enhance of Sumitra's joy, greatly angry and with his eyes full of tears.

sa: पितृव्यं निहतं श्रुत्वा देवान्तकनरान्तकौ। त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च रुरुदुः शोकपीडिताः॥
en: Hearing their uncle slain, Trisiras* and Atikāya-destroyers of gods and men, began to weep, oppressed with sorrow. *Three-headed.

sa: अवक्षिप्तावधूतानामसीनां वीरबाहुभिः। संजज्ञे तुमुलः शब्दः पततां परमर्मसु॥
en: The whiling noise of the swords made by their whirling and falling by heroic arms became very loud.

sa: गजानां पादरक्षास्तु व्यूढोरस्काः प्रहारिणः। ऋष्टिभिश्च धनुर्भिश्च विमलैश्च परश्वधैः॥ गदाभिर्मुसलैश्चैव भिन्दिपालैः सतोमरैः। आयसैः परिपैश्चैव निस्त्रिंशैविमलैः शितैः॥ प्रगृहीतैः सुसंरब्धा द्रवमाणास्ततस्ततः। व्यदृश्यन्त महाराज परस्परजिघांसवः॥
en: O king, the foot-soldiers, that protected the elephants, that possessed broad chests, that were capable of effectually striking the foe, armed with pikes, bows, bright battle-axes, maces, clubs, arrows, lances, shafts and heavy iron-mounted bludgeons and swords of the brightest polish, ran in every direction with the firm resolve of taking one another's life.

sa: परिवेदयमानस्य दुःखार्तस्य महात्मनः। तिष्ठतो राजपुत्रस्य शर्वरी सात्यवर्तत॥
en: As the high-souled son of the king oppressed with grief was thus lamenting sitting up, the day broke.

sa: सुरतामर्दविच्छिन्नाः स्वर्गस्त्रीहारमौक्तिकाः। पतन्ति चातुला दिक्षु तोयधाराः समन्ततः॥
en: And watery drops resembling the pearls of the necklaces used by celestial damsels are pouring on all sides.

sa: उच्चैःश्रवा हयश्रेष्ठो मणिरत्नं च कौस्तुभम्। उदतिष्ठन्नरश्रेष्ठ तथैवामृतमुत्तमम्॥
en: O foremost of men, next arose ucchaiśravā best of horses, and also Kaustubha; and next, the excellent ambrosia.

sa: नास्ति सत्यात् परो धर्मो नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं नास्ति प्रेत्य चेह च भूतये॥
en: There is no duty higher than Truth. There is no one more worthy of respect than the mother. There is none more efficient than the Brahmana for conferring happiness both in this world and the next.

sa: नाप्येवं वेगवान्वायुर्गरुडो न मनस्तथा। यथायं वायुपुत्रस्तु क्रमतेऽम्बरमुत्तमम्॥
en: The velocity, with which Marut's son is going, is not possessed even by the Wind, Garuda and mind.

sa: 'उपाध्यायिनी ते ऋतुमती। उपाध्यायश्च प्रोषितः अस्या यथाऽयमृतुर्वन्ध्यो न भवति, तथा क्रियताम् एषा विषीदति' इति॥
en: "O Uttanka, the wife of your preceptor is in the state in which she might bear a child. Your preceptor is absent, therefore you are requested to stand in his place and do what is needful."

sa: ततः संदर्शनेऽतिष्ठं रामस्यातितपस्विनः। प्रगृह्य शङ्खप्रवरं ततः प्राधममुत्तमम्॥
en: Coming within the sight of that excellent ascetic Rama, I took my good conch and loudly blew it.

sa: तत्र वै मानुषाल्लोकाद् दानादिभिरतन्द्रितः। अहिंसार्थसमायुक्तैः कारणैः स्वर्गमश्नुते॥
en: By charity, unenviousness, absence of slothfulness and by self-exertion one goes to heaven from this state of men.

sa: भ्रमराचरिता यत्र सर्वकालफलद्रुमाः॥ यं सूर्यस्तुल्यवर्णाभमनुपर्येति पर्वतम्। यस्य भासा सदा भान्ति तद्वर्णा मृगपक्षिणः॥ यस्य प्रस्थं महात्मानो न त्यजन्ति महर्षयः। सर्वकामफला वृक्षाः सर्वे फलसमन्विताः॥ मधूनि च महार्हाणि यस्मिन्पर्वतसत्तमे। तत्रैष रमते राजनम्ये काञ्चनपर्वते॥ मुख्यो वानरमुख्यानां केसरी नाम यूथपः।
en: Where the trees bring forth fruits of every season and the black bees resort, in the mountain furnished with solar splendour, which the Sun circumambulates, by whose radiance ever beam beasts and birds with like hue, whose table-lands are never forsaken by magnanimous Maharșis; where the trees yield every object of desire and all are fraught with fruits; in which best of mountains excellent honey is founds, there in the charming Golden hill, O king, sport this one—the foremost of the principal monkeys, Kaśarī by name, a leader of bands.

sa: तस्मात् प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्। पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्॥
en: Therefore, O Lord, O adorable One, bowing to you, prostrating before you, I ask your grace. You should overlook my faults, O God,, as father does his son's a friend his friend's a lover his lover's.

sa: भूयः स चिन्तयामास मुहूर्ते कपिकुञ्जरः। कथमस्मद्विधस्येह बन्धनं राक्षसाधमैः॥ प्रतिक्रियास्य युक्ता स्यात् सति मह्यं पराक्रमे।
en: Then the elephantine monkey again reflected for a while, “Why should one like me suffer one's self to be bound by vile Rākşasas? Therefore it is meet that I should, displaying my prowess, avenge (this wrong)."

sa: ये च मूढतमा लोके ये च बुद्धेः परं गताः। ते नराः सुखमेधन्ते क्लिश्यत्यन्तरितो जनः॥
en: They whose understandings are dormant, and they who have that state of the mind which lies beyond the range of the intellect, succeed in enjoying happiness. Only they who are between these two classes, suffer misery.

sa: स्तदा महास्त्रप्रतिमन्त्रितेन। पाथोऽपराह्ने शिर उच्चकर्त वैकर्तनस्याथ महेन्द्रसूनुः॥
en: With that powerful Anjalika weapon inspired with mantras Indra's son cut-off the head of Vaikartana in the afternoon.

sa: हस्तिनोऽश्वाश्च गावचाप्युष्ट्राश्वतरगर्दभाः। अधर्मभूते नृपतौ सर्वे सीदन्ति जन्तवः॥
en: Elephants, horses, kine, camels, mules, asses and other animals all lose their vigour when the king becomes sinful.

sa: अथर्षयश्च देवाश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तदा॥ सरस्वती तथा दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर्भृशदुःखिताः।
en: Beholding the Sarasvati in that plights the gods, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras became filled with great sorrow.

sa: गच्छ शीघ्रं प्रदग्धुं त्वं ततो मोक्ष्यसि किल्बिषात्। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं परमेष्ठिमुखाच्च्युतम्॥ उत्तमं जवमास्थाय प्रदुद्राव हुताशनः। आगम्य खाण्डवं दावमुत्तमं वीर्यमास्थितः। सहसा प्राज्वलच्चाग्निः क्रुद्धो वायुसमीरितः॥
en: Go there soon to consume it with all its living creatures. You will then certainly be cured of your malady." Having heard these words that were uttered by the Supreme Deity, Agni proceeded with great speed (towards that great forest). Arriving at the fearful Khandava forest in full vigour, he suddenly blazed up with the help of the wind.

sa: येऽर्था धर्मेण ते सत्या येऽधर्मेण धिगस्तु तान्। धर्मं वै शाश्वतं लोके न जह्याद् धनकाझ्या॥
en: That wealth which acquired by fair means is true wealth. Fie on that wealth however, which is acquired by unfair means. Virtue is eternal. It should never, in this world, be renounced from desire of riches.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्न उवाच अहं द्रोणं हनिष्यामि शिखण्डी तु पितामहम्। दुर्योधनं भीमसेनः कर्णं हन्ताधनंजयः॥ रामकृष्णौ व्यपाश्रित्य अजेयाः स्म रणे स्वसः। अपि वृत्रहणा युद्धे किं पुनधृतराष्ट्रजे॥
en: Dhristadyumna said : I shall kill Drona, Sikhandi will kill the Grandsire (Bhishma), Bhimasena will kill Duryodhana and Karna will be killed by Dhananjaya (Arjuna). O sister, with the assistance of Rama (Baladeva) and Krishna we are invincible even in a battle with the slayer of Vritra (Indra), what (to speak of a battle) with the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: एवमुक्तो भगवता व्यासेन पृथिवीपतिः। युधिष्ठिरं सहामात्यमनुजज्ञे नदीसुतः॥
en: Thus addressed by the holy Vyasa, the royal son of Shantanu and Ganga dismissed Yudhishthira and his counsellors.

sa: ततो भीष्मनिहन्ता तं सह सर्वैः प्रभद्रकैः। अहनत् सर्वतो वीरं नानाप्रहरणैर्बली॥ शिलीमुखेन चान्येन भ्रुवोर्मध्ये समार्पयत्।
en: the destroyer of Bhishma, viz., the great Shikhandin, with all the Prabhadrakas, assailed the hero from every side with various sorts of Weapors. Shikhandin struck Ashvatthaman with an arrow in the midst of his two eyebrows.

sa: कर्णश्चामरसंकाशो युयुधानश्च सात्यकिः। अन्योन्यं तौ महाराज शरवर्षैरवर्षताम्॥
en: O mighty monarch, Karna who resembled a god and Yuyudhana Satyaki showered upon each other volleys of arrows.

sa: प्रयुतं रक्षसामत्र पश्चिमद्वारमाश्रितम्। चर्मखङ्गधराः सर्वे तथा सर्वास्त्रकोविदाः॥
en: And a prayuta of Rākṣasas, bearing swords and shields, and skilled in all arms, protect the Western gate.

sa: सान्तरायुधिनश्चैव द्विपास्तीक्ष्णविषोपमाः। विदन्त्यसुरमायां ये सुघोरा घोरचक्षुषः॥ यवनाः पारदाश्चैव शकाश्च सह बाह्निकैः। काकवर्णा दुराचाराः स्त्रीलोकाः कलहप्रियाः॥ द्राविडास्तत्र युध्यन्ते मत्तमातङ्गविक्रमाः। गोयोनिप्रभवाम्लेच्छा: कालकल्पाः प्रहारिणः॥
en: Many other elephants armed with weapons and fierce like snakes of virulent poison, also did the same. Numerous furious Yavanas, Paradas, Shakas, Balhikas and Mlechhas born of the cow (of Vasishtha) possessed of fearful eyes, accomplished in smitting, looking like emissaries of Death, all versed in the use of illusive powers of the Asuras.

sa: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रो भूत्वा च पुनरेव स राक्षसः॥ सागरोमिरिवोद्भूतस्तिर्यगूर्ध्वमवर्तत।
en: Once again he became small about the transversely or soared high like the surging billows of the ocean.

sa: इत्युक्तास्ते ततः सर्वे समन्तादवभाषिरे। कर्णोऽहं भीमसेनोऽहमर्जुनोऽहमिति प्रभो॥
en: Thus addressed, they answered him from all sides, saying, I am Karna! I am Bhimasena! I am Arjuna!

sa: इयं कुसुमसंघातैरुपस्तीर्णा सुखाकृता। स्वयं निपतितैभूमिः शयनप्रस्तरैरिव ॥
en: This forest-land, strewn with flowers dropping spontaneously from the trees like to a bed sheet, has become pleasant.

sa: पद्मकेसरसंसृष्टो वृक्षान्तरविनिःसृतः। निःश्वास इव सीताया वाति वायुमनोहरः॥
en: Issuing out of the trees and touching the filaments, the pleasant wind is blowing like to Sita's breath.

sa: सूतश्चित्ररथश्चार्यः सचिवः सुचिरोषितः। तोषयैनं महाहैश्च रत्नैर्वस्त्रैर्धनैस्तथा॥ पशुकाभिश्च सर्वाभिर्गवां दशशतेन च। ये च मे कठकालापा बहवो दण्डमाणवाः॥ नित्यस्वाध्यायशीलत्वान्नान्यत् कुर्वन्ति किंचन। अलसा: स्वादुकामाश्च महतां चापि सम्मताः॥ तेषामशीतियानानि रत्नपूर्णानि दापय। शालिवाहसहस्रं च द्वे शते भद्रकांस्तथा॥ व्यञ्जनार्थं च सौमित्रे गोसहस्रमुपाकुरु। मेखलीनां महासङ्घः कौसल्यां समुपस्थितः। तेषां सहस्रं सौमित्रे प्रत्येकं सम्प्रदापय॥ अम्बा यथा नो नन्देच्च कौसल्या मम दक्षिणाम्। तथा द्विजातीस्तान्
en: Do you propitiate the worshipful Citraratha, who is our charioteer and counsellor and of advanced years, with precious jewels, clothes, wealth, with all kinds of beasts and a thousand cows. Do you confer upon those Brāhmaṇas, O son of Sumitrā, who live under my protection, studying the Katha section of Yajur Veda, with staffs in their hands. a grant of eighty mules loaded with jewels, of a thousand miles of pines, and of a thousand cows, for curd and clarified butter. They are always inactive, being constantly engaged in Vedic studies, and are greatly slothful though having a taste for delicious food, and are always esteemed by great men; to each of all those Brahmanas, who always come to Kausalya, do you, O Laksmana, make a grant of a thousand gold coins, and offer to them all such gifts

sa: तं नखैर्दशनैश्चापि मुष्टिभिबाहुभिस्तथा। कुम्भकर्ण महाबाहुं निजघ्नुः प्लवगर्षभाः॥
en: And those foremost of monkeys attacked the long-armed Kumbhakarma with their claws and teeth and blows and arms.

sa: विक्षिप्तां पवनेनैतामसौ तिलकमञ्जरीम्। षट्पदः सहसाभ्येति मदोद्भूतामिव प्रियाम्॥
en: The Bhramaras (black-bees) are approaching the flower-stalk of Tilaka trees tossed by the wind like to intoxicated damsels.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवं पृष्टा प्रीतियुक्तेन तेन शुश्रूषुमीक्ष्योत्तमबुद्धियुक्तम्। तालुं विप्रंधर्मयुक्तं हितं च सरस्वती वाक्यमिदं बभाषे॥
en: Markandeya said : Thus questioned by that cheerful Rishi and having seen him eager to learn and at the same time possessed of great intelligence, Sarasvati spoke these virtuous and beneficial words to the Brahmana Tarkshya.

sa: तथा संपूज्य तमृर्षि तद्धनं प्रतिगृह्य च। पृष्ट्वा प्रतिपदं सर्वं कुशलं मातुलस्य च॥ उपविष्टं महाभागं रामः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे। किमाह मातुलो वाक्यं यदर्थ भगवानिह ॥ प्राप्तो वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठः साक्षादिव बृहस्पतिः।
en: Having thus welcomed that foremost of Rșis and accepted the valuable presents sent by his maternal uncle he asked the ascetic about his welfare in every thing. There upon the great Rșis being seated, he said. You are the foremost of those skilled in the are of speech like the very preceptor of the celestials. Since your own self has here My uncle must have commissioned you with a very important message.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच काश्यपो ाथ वासिष्ठः प्राणश्च प्राणपुत्रकः। अग्निराङ्गिरसश्चैव च्यवनस्त्रिषु वर्चकः॥ अचरन्त तपस्तीव्र पुत्रार्थे बहुवार्षिकम्। पुत्रं लभेम धर्मिष्ठं यशसा ब्रह्मणा समम्॥ महाव्यातिभिातः पञ्चभिस्तैस्तदा त्वथ। जज्ञे तेजो महार्चिष्मान् पञ्चवर्णः प्रभावनः॥
en: Markandeya said : He performed severe asceticism lasting for many hundred years with the desire of getting a virtuous son equal to a Brahmana, in reputation when invocation was made with Vyahriti hymns and with the aid of the five sacred fires, namely Kashyapa, Vasishtha, Pranaka, the son of Prana, the son of Angira, Chyavana and Trivarcha, there was a bright fire full of the animating principle and of five different colours.

sa: द्विविदं वानरेन्द्रं तं दुमयोधिनमाहवे। शरैरशनिसंकाशैः स विव्याधाशनिप्रभः॥
en: Asaniprabha in encounter pierced that foremost of monkeys bearer of trees in conflict, Dvivida, with shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

sa: ददाति यो वै कपिलां सचैलां कांस्योपदोहां द्रविणैरुत्तरीयैः। तैस्तैर्गुणैः कामदुहाथ भूत्वा नरं प्रदातारमुपैति सा गौः॥
en: When a man gives away a well-caparisoned Kapila cow with money and with a bronze milk pot, he finds that cow, becoming a giver of boons, has come to his side by her own distinguished qualities,

sa: भ्रातृणां सौदराणां च तथैवास्याभवच्छतम्। मद्राधिपस्याश्वपतेर्मालब्यां सुमहद् बलम्॥
en: She had also one hundred highly powerful uterine brothers begotten by Ashvapati, the king of Madra, on Malavi.

sa: योजनानां शतान्यूज़ पञ्चोच्छ्रितमरिंदम्। शतानि विस्तरेणाथ त्रीण्येवाभ्यधिकानि वै॥
en: He was full five hundred Yojanas in height, 0 chastiser of enemies and three hundred Yojanas in circumference.

sa: उपाध्यायं पुरस्कृत्य कश्यपं मुनिसत्तमम्॥ अयज वाजपेयेन सोऽश्वमेधशतेन च। प्रददौ दक्षिणां चैव पृथिवीं वै ससागराम्॥
en: Then Rama performed in that Tirtha a Vajapeya sacrifice and a hundred horse sacrifices through the assistance of his preceptor Kashyapa. There, as sacrificial fee, Rama gave to his preceptor the whole Earth with her oceans.

sa: असितो देवलश्चैव तस्मिन्नेव महातपाः। परमं योगमास्थाय ऋषिर्योगमवाप्तवान्॥
en: Having bathed in that very Tirtha with a concentrated mind, the Rishi Asita-Deval also obtained great Yoga powers.

sa: तेऽतिकार्य समासाद्य वानरा मूढचेतसः। शरण्यं शरणं जग्मुर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजमाहवे॥
en: On Atikāya appearing before them, the monkeys stupefied in that conflict, saught the shelter of Laksmana's elder brother.

sa: युयुधानो महाराज यन्तारमिदमब्रवीत्। कृतवर्मा रथेनैष द्रुतमापतते शरी॥
en: O mighty Monarch, Yuyudhana addressed his charioteer saying-Yonder is the heroic Kritavarman rushing at me on his chariot.

sa: पार्थाञ्जित्वाजयचेदीन् पञ्चालान् सृञ्जयानपि। केकयांश्च महावीर्यान् कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Conquering the Parthas, the mighty carwarrior Kritavarman vanquished the Chedis, the Panchaias, the Srinjayas and the valourous Kekayas.

sa: स तथाभिहतस्तेन हनूमान् प्लवगोत्तमः। मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास बलेनातिमहाबलः॥
en: Being thus hurt that highly powerful Hanumān, the foremost of the monkeys, with great velocity clenched his fist.

sa: सप्तरात्रेण राजासौ सपुत्रबलवाहनः। पापकर्मसमाचारो वधं प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः॥
en: Within seven nights, the wicked and vicious Daņda, with his son, soldiers and retinue, shall meet with death.

sa: अथैनं शरधाराभिर्धाराभिरिव तोयदः। अभ्यवर्षत संक्रुद्धो लक्ष्मणो रावणात्मजम्।१२।।
en: Then as a mass of clouds poured down showers, Laksmana, enraged, poured volleys of shafts on Rāvana's son.

sa: देवि हयृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः। सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: O noble lady, that lord and foremost of monkeys, Sugrīva gifted with strength, is determined on your behalf.

sa: यक्षसेनः सपुत्रश्च शाल्वश्च वसुधाधिपः। प्राग्ज्योतिषश्च नृपतिर्भगदत्तो महारथः॥
en: Yakshasena with his sons, that lord of the earth Shalva, the great car-warrior, Bhagadatta, the king of Pragjyotisha.

sa: प्रहसंश्चाब्रवीद् वाक्यं चेदिराजः प्रतापवान्। भीमसेनमभिक्रुद्धं दृष्ट्वा भीमपराक्रमम्॥
en: Seeing Bhima of terrible prowess in such great rage, the mighty kings of Chedi laughingly spoke thus. was

sa: दृष्ट्वा त्वरितमायान्तं भीमं युद्धाभिनन्दिनम्। सूतपुत्रमथोवाच मद्राणामीश्वरो विभुः॥
en: Beholding Bhima, who takes delight in battle, advance quickly, the king of Madras said to the charioteer's son.

sa: वर्जयित्वा श्मशानानि देवताऽऽयतनानि च। वल्मीकांश्चैत्यवृक्षांश्च तन्निविष्टमभूद् बलम्॥
en: Avoiding cremation-grounds, temples of gods, sacred trees and grounds covered with ant-hills, his army occupied every other places.

sa: सूत रत्नसुसम्पूर्णा चतुर्विधबला चमूः। राघवस्यानुयात्रार्थं क्षिप्रं प्रतिविधीयताम्॥
en: O charioteer, do you speedily Marshall the army consisting of the four kinds of forces for following Rāghava.

sa: सोऽभिजात्या च भक्त्या च सख्यस्याचार्यकस्य च। सौहृदस्य च वीर्यस्य कुलीनत्वस्य माधव॥ सत्यस्य च महाबाहो अनुकम्पार्थमेव च। अनुरूपं महेष्वास कर्म त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: For showing kindness, therefore, to one who is your friend and preceptor, O mightyarmed hero, it behoves you, who are of noble lineage and who cherish reverence for us, to act in a way, O great bowman, worthy of your friendship, prowess, nobility of birth and devotion to truth, O descendant of Madhu's race.

sa: आसामुभयतः कूलं पाण्डुमृत्तिकलेपनाः। रम्याश्चावसथा दिव्या ब्राह्मणस्य प्रसादजाः॥
en: And at the pleasure of the Brāhmaṇa, on both their banks arose charming dwellings, covered with pale clay.

sa: तमारोप्य रथोपस्थे मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥ अपोवाह महाबाहुं तूर्णमायोधनादपि।
en: Taking Kritavarman upon his car before all the bowmen, the mighty-armed Kripa took him away from the battlefield.

sa: ततः प्रहृष्टवदनः सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणाग्रजे। वैरस्य कारणं तत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Then with a cheerful countenance, Sugrīva began to unfold to Lakşmaņa's elder brother the cause of their hostility.

sa: ततः प्रहृष्टवदनः सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणाग्रजे। वैरस्य कारणं तत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Then with a cheerful countenance, Sugrīva began to unfold to Lakşmaņa's elder brother the cause of their hostility.

sa: भवान् राज्य न मन्युर्हदि नः कश्चित् सुयोधनकृतेऽनघ। भवितव्यं तथा तद्धि वयं चान्ये च मोहिताः॥
en: O sinless one, I cherish no resentment in my heart on account of the wrongs done to us by Suyodhana. It was ordained that it should be so. Both ourselves and others were stupefied (by fate).

sa: महेन्द्रपर्वतं दृष्ट्वा तापसैरुपशोभितम्। समुद्रतीरेण शनैर्मणिपूरं जगाम ह॥
en: Seeing the Mahendra mountain adorned with the ascetics and going slowly along the sea-shores, he went to Manipur.

sa: यदाश्रौषं कर्णघटोत्कचाभ्यां युद्धे मुक्तां सूतपुत्रेण शक्तिम्। यया वध्यः समरे सव्यसाची तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that in the fight between Karna and Ghatotkacha, the Shakti, had been hurled against Ghatotkacha by Karna, the weapon which should have certainly killed Arjuna.

sa: तस्य कन्या पृथा नाम रूपेणासदृशी भुवि। पितुः स्वस्त्रीयपुत्राय सोऽनपत्याय वीर्यवान्॥ अग्रमग्रे प्रतिज्ञाय स्वस्यापत्यस्य वै तदा। अग्रजातेति तां कन्यां शूरोऽनुग्रहकांक्षया॥ अददत्कुन्तिभोजाय स तां दुहितरं तदा। सा नियुक्ता पितुर्गेहे ब्राह्मणातिथिपूजने॥
en: His daughter was named Pritha, who was matchless on earth in beauty. Her father (Shura) promised before Fire that he would give his first-born child to the son of his paternal aunt, king Kuntibhoja, who was childless. He gave his daughter (Pritha) to that king, expecting to get his favour. And king Kuntibhoja, adopted her as his daughter. She was engaged in her (foster) father's house in attending upon Brahmanas and guests.

sa: हितं तु परमं कर्ण ब्रवीमि कुलवर्धनम्। अथ त्वं मन्यसे दुष्टं ब्रूहि यत् परमं हितम्॥
en: O Karna, know that what I have said is good for all. This is for the prosperity of the Kuru race. If you consider it as productive of evil, tell yourself what is the great good.

sa: स तां पद्मपलाशाक्षी पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्। वरुणो वरयामास मैथुनायाप्सरोवराम्॥
en: Thereupon he expressed his intention of living with that queen of Apsarās, having a moon-like countenance and lotus-eyes.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तयोश्च तद्वीर्यमप्रमेयममानुषम्। शङ्कमानौ पाण्डवांस्तान् रामकृष्णौ महामती॥
en: The doubting by Rama and Krishna from the great exploits of the brothers that whether they were Pandavas.

sa: कोटिशश्च सुवर्णं च तेषामकृतकं तथा। वीथीकृतममेयात्मा प्राहिणोन्मधुसूदनः॥
en: Madhusudan (Krishna) of immeasurable soul sent to them also in separate heaps millions of coins of pure gold.

sa: नित्योत्थितः शुचिः शक्तो महाभारतमादितः। तपो नियममास्थाय कृतमेतन्महर्षिणा॥
en: Rising daily (in the morning), purifying himself (by ablutions) and performing all his religious (he composed this Mahabharata).

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्य दायादा दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः। भूषिता भूषणैश्चित्रैः शतसंख्या विनिर्ययुः॥
en: The hundred sons of Dhritarashtra, with Duryodhana at their head, all decked with various ornaments, also came out.

sa: स सम्प्राप्य शुभान् कामांस्तृप्तः खित्रश्च पार्थिवः। कालं वर्षसहस्रान्तं सस्मार मनुजाधिपः॥ परिसंख्याय कालज्ञः कला: काष्ठाश्च वीर्यवान्। यौवनं प्राप्य राजर्षिः सहस्रपरिवत्सरान्॥ विश्वाच्या सहितो रेमे व्यभ्राजन्नन्दने वने। अलकायां स कालं तु मेरुशृङ्गे तथोत्तरे॥ यदा स पश्यते कालं धर्मात्मा तं महीपतिः। पूर्णं मत्वा ततः कालं पूरूं पुत्रमुवाच ह॥
en: The king (Yayati) became exceedingly happy in thus being able to enjoy all the best objects of enjoyments. That king of men was only sorry (in remembering) that one thousand years would soon come to an end. That royal sage, learned in the mystery of time and possessed of great prowess, having obtained youth for one thousand years and watching proper Kalas and Kashthas. Sported with Vishvachi (Apsara), some time in the garden (of Indra) Nandana, sometimes in Aloka and sometimes on the summit of the Meru Mountain. That virtuous king then found that the fixed time (one thousand) years had come to an end. He then called Puru and addressed him thus.

sa: मम कन्या सनाम्नी या भैक्ष्यवच्चोदिता भवेत्। भरेयं चैव यां नाहं तां मे कन्यां प्रयच्छत॥
en: A bride, who bears the same name with me, who will be given to me as a gift and whom I shall not have to maintain,(If there is such a bride), O bestow her on me.

sa: मम कामः स च कृतः पूरुणा मित्ररूपिणा। शुक्रेण च वरो दत्तः काव्येनोशनसा स्वयम्॥ पुत्रो यस्त्वानुवर्तेत स राजा पृथिवीपतिः। भवतोऽनुनयाम्येवं पूरू राज्येऽभिषिच्यताम्॥
en: Puru is a great friend of mine and he did what was agreeable to me. And the son of Kavi, Ushanas, Shukra himself, granted me this boon. The son who would obey me would become the king and the lord of the earth. Therefore, I entreat you, let Puru be installed on the throne.

sa: ततः स्नेहाद्धरिहयं दृष्ट्वा रङ्गावलोकिनम्। भास्करोऽप्यनयन्नाशं समीपोपगतान् घनान्॥
en: Seeing that Indra was thus showing his affection (towards Arjuna), the sun dispersed the clouds over his son.

sa: प्रणिधायेन्द्रियग्रामं भर्तृलोकपरायणे। त्यक्तकामसुखे ह्यावां तप्स्यावो विपुलं तपः॥
en: We shall also perform great asceticism with our husband, controlling our passions and abandoning all desires and pleasures.

sa: नागाः सुपर्णाः पशवः पितामहमुपासते। स्थावरा जङ्गमाश्चैव महाभूतास्तथापरे॥
en: The Nagas, the birds, the various other animals, all other mobile and immobile great beings, worship the Grandsire.

sa: तत्र यज्ञो महानासीद्बहुवर्षगणायुतः। समृद्धः परया लक्ष्म्या देवयज्ञसमोऽभवत्॥
en: It continued for many Ayuta years. For immense riches the sacrifice appeared like one performed by the celestials.

sa: भूमिरत्नादिभिर्दानैस्तथा पूज्या भवन्ति ते। वरदानमहायज्ञैस्तथा शक्रोत्सवेन च॥
en: With the gifts of lands, gems and precious stones, like king Vasu, become much respected in the worlds.

sa: चकार मृगयां कामी गिरिकामेव संस्मरन्। अतीवरूपसंपन्नां साक्षाछियमिवापराम्॥
en: Went out to hunt (the deer), thinking of Girika who was exceedingly beautiful and was like Sree herself.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्तु पुत्रेण श्रुत्वा वचनमीरितम्। मुहूर्तमिव संचिन्त्य दुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Dhritarashtra having heard these words of his son, reflected for a moment and then spoke to Duryodhana thus-

sa: तत्र ते स्तकृतास्तेन सुमहार्हपरिच्छदाः। उपास्यमानाः पुरुषैरूषुः पुरनिवासिभिः॥
en: Being served by Purochana and adored by the citizens, they (the Pandavas,) attired in costly robes, lived there.

sa: कच्चिद्धृष्टश्च शूरश्च मतिमान् धृतिमाञ्छुचिः। कुलीनश्चानुरक्तश्च दक्षः सेनापतिस्तथा॥
en: Is your commander-in-chief brave, intelligent, patient, well-conducted, nobly born, competent, devoted to you and a man of confidence?

sa: उद्गाता ब्राह्मणो वृद्धो विद्वान्कौत्सोऽथ जैमिनिः। ब्रह्माऽभूच्छाईरवोऽथाध्वर्युश्चापि पिङ्गलः॥
en: This learned old Brahmana, Kautsa became the Udgata, Jaimini became the Brahma, Shranagarava and Pingala became the Adhvaryus.

sa: इदं शतसहस्रं हि श्लोकानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्। सत्यवत्यात्मजेनेह व्याख्यातममितौजसा॥
en: This (Bharata) contains one lac sacred slokas, composed by the son of Satyavati, Vyasa of immeasurable mental power.

sa: समीपे नगरस्यास्य बको वसति राक्षसः। ईशो जनपदस्यास्य पुरस्य च महाबलः॥ पुष्टो मानुषमांसेन दुर्बुद्धिः पुरुषादकः। रक्षत्यसुररानित्यमिमं जनपदं बली॥ नगरं चैव देशं च रक्षोबलसमन्वितः। तत्कृते परचक्राच्च भूतेब्यश्च न नो भयम्॥
en: A Rakshasas, named Baka, lives not far off from this town. That greatly powerful (cannibal) is the lord of this town and of this country. That wicked-minded and powerful cannibal, that chief of the Asuras, being fattened by (eating) human flesh, rules over this country. This country and town are protected by the strength of that Rakshasas; thus being protected, we have no fear of any enemy, nay of any living soul.

sa: तानुवाच हृषीकेशः समाश्वास्य महामनाः। युधिष्ठिरो राजसूयं क्रतुमाहर्तुमिच्छति॥
en: Giving them every assurance, thus replied to them Hrishikesha (Krishna), "Yudhishthira is desirous of performing the Rajasuya (sacrifice).

sa: तमद्रिकूटसदृशं विनिकीर्णं भयानकम्। दृष्ट्वा संहृष्टरोमाणो बभूवुस्तत्र नागराः॥
en: The citizens' hair stood on end when they saw the fearful cannibal, as huge as a mountain cliff.

sa: सम्प्रहृष्टमना द्रोणो रामात् परमसम्मतम्। ब्रह्मास्त्रं समनुप्राप्य नरेष्वभ्यधिकोऽभवत्॥
en: Obtaining from Rama that great weapon called Brahmastra, Drona became exceeding glad and acquired superiority over all men.

sa: ततो वायुर्महाघोषः क्षोभयन् सर्वसागरान्। वियत्स्थो जनयन् मेघाञ्जलधारासमाकुलान्॥
en: Then greatly roaring winds, agitating all the oceans, gathered together masses of clouds charged with torrents of rains.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स्त्वं चोदरे तिष्ठसि ब्रूहि विप्र॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Shukra then asked him, “O Brahmana, how have you entered my stomach. Tell me truth."

sa: इति संदिश्य बहुशो मुनिः प्राचेतसस्तदा। वाल्मीकिः परमोदारस्तूष्णीमासीन्महामुनिः॥
en: Having in this wise given counsels, the highly generous and great ascetic Vālmīki, son of Pracetā, became silent.

sa: कदूश्च विनताचैव दाक्षायण्यौ विहायसा। आलोकयन्त्यावक्षोभ्यं समुद्र निधिमम्भसाम्॥
en: Kadru and Vinata, the daughters of Daksha, saw on their way the ocean, incapable of being easily disturbed.

sa: तस्मिन्गीते तु विज्ञाय सीतापुत्रौ कुशीलवौ। तस्याः परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत्॥ दूताशुद्धसमाचारानाहूयात्ममनीषया। मद्वचो ब्रूत गच्छध्वमितो भगवतोऽन्तिके॥ यदि शुद्धसमाचारा यदि वा वीतकल्मषा। करोत्विहात्मनः शुद्धिमनुमान्य महामुनिम्॥
en: And understanding from the story that Kusa and Lava were Janaki's sons, Rāma mentioning her name said before the assembly:-Send a good emissary to the illustrious Vālmīki and let him communicate to the ascetics that if Janaki is sinless and has lead a pure life in the forest; let her give proof of purity by the great ascetic's permission.

sa: वनराजीस्तु पश्येमाः पिप्पलानां मनोरमाः। पार्थ गौतमौकः समीपजाः॥
en: O Partha, behold the charming forest of Pipalas and beautiful Lodhras standing near the place where Goutama lived.

sa: ततो भगवता तस्य शिरश्छिन्नमलंकृतम्। चक्रायुधेन चक्रेण पिबतोऽमृतमोजसा॥
en: Narayana immediately with his discus cut off the well-adorned head of the Danava who was drinking the Ambrosia.

sa: शुश्रूषुरनहंवादी शुचिः पौरवनन्दनः। अंशुमन्तं समुद्यन्तं पूजयामास भक्तिमान्॥
en: The descendant of Puru (Samvarana) worshipped the deity, effulgent in all his glory, with devotion, humanity and piety.

sa: ततो नानाविधास्तत्र सुस्रुवुः सागराम्भसि। महाद्रुमाणां निर्यासा बहवश्चौषधीरसाः॥
en: Then the gums of various great trees and juices from herbs mingled with the waters of the ocean.

sa: स तु वारितवान्मोहात्काश्यपं द्विजसत्तमम्। संजिजीवयिषु प्राप्तं राजानमपराजितम्॥
en: He, being ignorant of my anger, prevented that best of Brahmana, Kashyapa, from coming to my unconquerable father.

sa: किमर्थं मोक्षिताश्चैव पन्नगास्तेन धीमता। आस्तीकेन द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यशेषतः॥
en: Why were they saved by wise Astika, the best of Brahmanas? I am desirous of hearing all this.

sa: तमुवाचाथ राजर्षिर्द्विजं मित्रसहस्तदा। आस्स्व ब्रह्मंस्त्वमत्रैव मुहूर्त प्रतिपालयन्॥
en: The royal sage (Kalmashapada) with his friends said to the Brahmana, “O Brahmana, Stay here for a moment,

sa: अनुज्ञातोऽथ कृष्णस्तु ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना। निषसादासनाभ्यासे प्रीयमाणः शुचिस्मितः॥
en: But being commanded by Parameshti, Brahma, full of love, he sat down near the seat; smiling in joy.

sa: जनमेजयेन पृष्टः सन्ब्राह्मणैश्च सहस्रशः॥ शशास शिष्यमासीनं वैशंपायनमन्तिके।
en: When he was earnestly solicited by Janamejaya and thousands of Brahmanas, he taught it to his disciple Vaishampayana.

sa: ततोऽप्यर्धशतं भूयः संक्षेपं कृतवानृषिः॥ अनुक्रमणिकाध्यायं वृत्तान्तानां सपर्वणाम्।
en: He subsequently composed an epitome in one hundred and fifty verses, an index of the chapters of contents.

sa: एक एवोत्तमबलः क्षुत्पिपासाश्रमान्वितः। स वनस्यान्तमासाद्य महच्छून्यं समासदत्॥
en: Alone, fatigued with hunger and thirst he came to a large desert at the end of the forest.

sa: यत्राहं संक्षयिष्यामि शापं ब्राह्मणनिःसृतम्। वर्षघ्नमेकं श्वभ्रं तु हिमघ्नमपरं तथा॥ ग्रीष्मघ्नं तु सुखस्पर्शमेकं कुर्वन्तु शिल्पिनः।
en: Living therein I shall waste the curse of the Brāhmaṇas. Let the architects dog one den to protect me against the rains, one against the affliction of the winter and one against the distresses of summer.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच महायोगी ततः प्राह कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः। पठस्व पुत्र भद्रं ते प्रीयतां ते महेश्वरः।।शा
en: Vaishampayana said After Vasudeva had stopped, the great, Yogin, viz., Krishna Dvaipayana, addressed Yudhishthira, saying, O son, recite this hymn consisting of the thousand and eight names of Mahadeva, and let Maheshvara be pleased with you.

sa: यदा चायं न बिभेति यदा चास्मान्न बिभ्यति। यदा नेच्छति न द्वेष्टि ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When one ceases to fear all creatures and when all creatures cease to fear him, when one never desires for anything nor entertains hatred for anything, then he is said to acquire the dignity of Brahma.

sa: (वर्जयेददुपदेशं च सदैव ब्राह्मणो नृप। उपदेशं हि कुर्वाणो द्विजः कृच्छ्रमवाप्नुयात्।। नेषितव्यं सदा वाचा द्विजेन नृपसत्तम। न च प्रव्यक्तव्यमिह किञ्चिद् वर्णावरे जने॥)
en: Hence, O king, the Brahmana should avoid delivering instructions to such as are lowborn, for it was by giving instructions to a lowborn person a Brahmana came to grief. O best of kings, the Brahmana should never desire to acquire instruction from, or impart instruction to, a person who belongs to the lowest order.

sa: द्यावापृथिव्योरित्येष राजन् वेदेषु पठ्यते। तयोः शकलयोर्मध्यमाकाशमकरोत् प्रभुः॥
en: The lord then, it is seen in the Vedas, O king, placed the sky between Heaven and Earth.

sa: यश्चाधर्मं चरेल्लोभात् कामक्रोधावनुप्लवन्। धर्म्य पन्थानमाक्रम्य सानुबन्धो विनश्यति॥
en: He who, influenced by cupidity, desire and anger, practises unrighteousness, transgressing the path of righteousness, is completely destroyed.

sa: रुद्र उवाच वहवः पुरुषा ब्रह्मंस्त्वया सृष्टाः स्वयम्भुवा। सृज्यन्ते चापरे ब्रह्मन् स चैकः पुरुषो विराट॥
en: Rudra said Self-create you are. Many are the Souls that haven been created by you. Others again, O Brahman, are being created by you. The Infinite Soul, however, of whom you speak, is one and single.

sa: नीलशैलचयप्रख्यं वलाकाभूषिताम्बरम्॥ तत्र स्थितश्च भगवान् देव्या सह महाद्युतिः। तपसा तेजसा कान्त्या दीप्तया सह भार्यया।॥
en: Within that cloud was the powerful Mahadeva, himself of dazzling splendour, accompanied by his consort Uma. Indeed, the great God appeared to shine with his penances, energy, beauty, effulgence, and his beloved consort by his side.

sa: त्वयि चाहं द्विजश्रेष्ठ भवान् मयि न संशयः। लोकोऽयं भवतः सर्वः का चिन्ता मयि तेऽनघ॥
en: You have become dear to me and I have become dear to you. All the persons in this city are yours. What objection then, O sinless one, you have to pass some time in my house.

sa: स गृहस्थाश्रमरतस्तया सह सुदर्शनः। कुरुक्षेत्रेऽवसद् राजन्नोघवत्या समन्वितः॥
en: Sudarshana, o king, leading the domestic mode of life with Oghavati, used to live in Kurukshetra with her.

sa: इतरास्तु व्यजायन्त गन्धर्वांस्तुरगान् द्विजान्। गाश्च किंपुरुषान्मत्स्यानुद्भिज्जांश्च वनस्पतीन्॥
en: The other wives of Kashyapa gave births to Gandharvas, horses, birds, kine, Kimpurushas, fishes, and trees and plants.

sa: नारद उवाच कुत: सृष्टमिदं विश्वं ब्रह्मन् स्थावरजङ्गमम्। प्रलये च कमभ्येति तद् भवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे॥
en: Narada said Whence, O Brahmana, has this universe, consisting of mobile and iminobile objects, been created? When, again, the all-embracing destruction sets in, into whom does it merge! Let your learned self describe this to me.

sa: उपस्थोऽध्यात्ममित्याहुर्यथा योगप्रदर्शिनः। अधिभूतं तथाऽऽनन्दो दैवतं च प्रजापतिः॥
en: The organ of generation is called Spiritual. Its agreeable function is called Elemental and Prajapati is its Accidental.

sa: सोऽधीत्य निखिलान् वेदान् सरहस्यान् ससंग्रहान्।।२४ इतिहासं च कात्स्र्येन राजशास्त्राणि वा विभो। गुरवे दक्षिणां दत्त्वा समावृत्तो महामुनिः।।२५। उग्रं तयः समारेभे ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः।
en: Having read all the Vedas together with all their mysteries and abstracts, as also all the histories and the science of polity, O powerful king, the great ascetic returned home, after giving his preceptor the tuition-fee. Adopting the vow of celibacy, he then bagan to practise the austerest penances, concentrating all his attention thereon.

sa: ईर्ष्याभिमानलोभेषु कामक्रोधभयेषु च॥ स्पृहामोहाभिमानेषु लोकः सक्तो विमुह्यति।
en: to People, wedded jealousy, vanity, cupidity, lust, anger, fear, desire, carelessness, and pride, allow themselves to be stupefied.

sa: हंसाच शतपत्राश्च सारसाश्च सहस्रशः॥ प्रदक्षिणमवर्तन्त शुकाश्चाषाश्च भारत।
en: Thousands of Swans and Shatapatras and cranes, and many parrots and Chasas, O Bharata, wheeled over his head.

sa: सर्वं तुदति तत्पापं भवयञ्छिवमात्मना। कीटपक्षिपतङ्गानां तिरश्चामपि केशव॥६८।
en: Even worms, insects and birds, O Keshava, that devote themselves to Mahadeva are enabled to move about fearlessly.

sa: मुचुकुन्दान्मरुत्तश्च मरुत्तादपि रैवतः॥ रैवताद् युवनाश्वश्च युवनाश्वात्ततो रघुः।
en: Muchukunda gave it to Marutta, and Marutta to Raivata. Raivata gave it to Yuvanashva, and Yuvanashva to Raghu.

sa: पेतुरुल्का महोत्पाताः शाखाश्च मुमुचुर्दुमाः। अप्रशान्ता दिशः सर्वाः पवनश्चाशिवो ववौ॥ मुहुर्मुहुश्च भूतानि प्राव्यथन्त भयात् तथा।
en: Meteors, foreboding great calamities, passed through the sky. The branches of trees began to fall down. All the points of the horizon became unquite. Inauspicious winds blew. All creatures began to tremble with fear every moment.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यद्यस्ति दत्तमिष्टं वा ततस्तप्तं तथैव च। गुरूणां वापि शुश्रूषा तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said If there is any efficacy in gifts, in sacrifices, in penances, well done, and in dutiful services done to preceptors and other reverend elders, do you, O grandfather, speak of the same to me.

sa: एतद्धि परमं तेजो ब्राह्मणस्येह दृश्यते। सहस्त्रकिरणस्येव सवितुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Such is the energy of the Brahimana, like to that of the thousand-rayed Sun himself, on the Earth.

sa: प्राक्रोशत् पाण्डवानीके वसुदानश्च आगच्छत प्रहरत द्रुतं विपरिधावत॥
en: And king Vasudana began to shout loudly amidst the Pandava troops. 'Come, strike, rush upon the foe quickly.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एह्येहि पार्थ बीभत्सो मां परिष्वज पाण्डव। वक्तव्यमुक्तोऽस्मि हितं त्वया क्षान्तं च तन्मया॥
en: Yudhishthira said Come O Partha, O Vibhatsu, come and embrace me; O son of Pandu, you have addressed me in words befitting the position and for my good and I have forgive you for their expressions.

sa: घण्टाभिश्च गजेन्द्राणां भाण्डैश्च विविधैरपि। स्रग्भिश्च नानाभरणैर्वस्त्रैश्चैव महाधनैः॥
en: With the bells and many other ornaments of the best of elephants, garlands, various ornaments and costly dresses.

sa: विलम्बमानं तत् सैन्यमप्रदल्भमवस्थितम्। दृष्ट्वा प्राच्छादयद् बाणैरर्जुनः प्राणतपनैः॥
en: Arjuna, seeing that host in that humble plight and so confounded, began to shower death-dealing shafts upon them.

sa: घटोत्कचमभिक्रुद्धं बिभेद दशभिः शरैः। घटोत्कचोऽतिविद्धस्तु द्रोणपुत्रेण मर्मसु॥
en: Furiously pierced Ghatotkacha with ten arrows. Deeply pierced in the vital parts by the son of Drona, Ghatotkacha.

sa: शत्रुजयः शत्रुसहश्चित्रश्चित्रायुधो दृढः। चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च सप्तैते विनिपातिताः॥
en: Satrunjaya, Satrusaha, Chitra, Chitrayudha, Dridha, Chitrasena and Vikarna these seven sons of yours were then slain by Bhima.

sa: उभयोः सेनयोर्हर्षस्तुमुलः समपद्यत॥ सिंहनादरवाश्चासन् दध्मुः शङ्खांश्च सैनिकाः।
en: Both the armies experienced a great delight. The soldiers emitted forth roars like lions and blew their conches.

sa: चमूम्॥ कर्ण पश्य च संग्रामे कालयन्तं महारथान्॥
en: See, O Krishna, the Pandava army is flying away. Karna is making a havoc on our great car-warriors.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय कर्णो वैकर्तनस्तदा। नकुलं पञ्चभिर्बाणैर्जत्रुदेशे समार्पयत्॥
en: Then Karna, the son of Vikartana, grasping another bow, had shot upon Nakula five shafts in the shoulder-joint.

sa: ततो भीताः समुदैक्षन्त कर्णं राजन् सर्वे सैन्धवा बालिकाश्चा असम्मोहं पूजयन्तोऽस्य संख्ये सम्पश्यन्तो विजयं राक्षसस्य॥
en: was O king, then all the Saindhavas and Valhikas looked in fear at Karna whose senses were not confounded in that fight. And they all applauded him whether they looked at the triumphs of the Rakshasa.

sa: तदस्रं द्रोणपुत्रस्य तस्मिन् प्रतिसमस्यति। अवर्धत महाराज यथाग्निरनिलोद्धतः॥
en: That weapon of Drona's son directed against Bhimasena, swelled in fury like a conflagration assisted by the wind.

sa: ततो रथसहस्रेण द्विरदानां त्रिभिः शतैः॥ चतुर्दशसहस्रेस्तु तुरगाणां महाहवे। द्वाभ्यां शतसहस्राभ्यं पदातीनां च धन्विनाम्॥ शूराणांबल्धलक्ष्याणां विदितानां समन्ततः। अभ्यवर्तन्त कौन्तेयं छादयन्तो महारथाः॥ शरवर्षेमहाराज सर्वतः पाण्डुनन्दनम्।
en: Thereupon with thousand cars, three hundred elephants, fourteen thousand horses and two hundred thousand valiant footsoldiers, all well practised in aiming and highly skillful in all the ways of war and well armed with bows, the leaders of the Samanaptakas rushed towards the son of Kunti and covered the Pandavas, O king, with showers of shafts from all sides.

sa: मगधानामधिपतिर्जयत्सेनो महाबलः॥ अद्य सप्तैव चाहानि हतः संख्येऽभिमन्युना।
en: Ten mighty Jayatsena, the king of the Magadhas, was slain in battle by Abhimanyu these seven days past.

sa: खुरशब्दनिपातैश्च तुमुल: सर्वतोऽभवत्। ततः समभवद् युद्धं संध्यायामतिदारुणम्॥
en: And the noise of hoofs (that uproar) spread everywhere. Then there took place an awfully dreadful nocturnal battle.

sa: न कथंचन शस्राणि मोक्तव्यानीह केनचित्। अहमावारयिष्यामि द्रोणपुत्रास्रमाशुगैः॥
en: None should throw his weapons aside. I shall check the weapon of Drona's son with my swift-flying arrows.

sa: सुवर्णविकृतान् प्रासाशक्तीः कनकभूषणाः। जाम्बूनमयैः पट्टैर्बद्धाश्च विपुला गदाः॥
en: Look! At these prasa, saktis and heavy gadas trimmed, studded and made of gold so laid-on the ground.

sa: तत्र मे बुद्धित्पन्ना वाहयात्र महारथम्। नाहत्वा समरे कर्णं निवर्तिष्ये कथञ्चन॥ राधेयो ह्यन्यथा पार्थान् सृञ्जयांश्च महारथान्। निःशेषान् समरे कुर्यात् पश्यता नो जनार्दन॥
en: It would be well to go over there, so lead my big chariot in that direction, I am not going to return without killing Karna in that fight. O Janaradana, the whole hosts of the Pandavas and the Srinjayas will all be destroyed before our very face, unless this son of Radha be killed.'

sa: घटोत्कचं तथा शूरं राक्षसं क्रूरकर्मिणम्। अलायुधोऽद्रवत् क्रुद्धमायान्तमाहवे॥
en: Alayudha quickly rushed upon that various Rakshasa Ghatotkacha of fierce deeds who was proceeding to battle with fury.

sa: अपरे कृष्यमाणाश्च विचेष्टन्तो महीतले। भावान् बहुविधांश्चक्रुस्ताडिताः शरतोमरैः॥
en: Others, wounded with arrows or dragged, fell down on the earth making diverse kinds of motion in agony.

sa: निहत्य तान् रणे सर्वान् पञ्चालान् पाण्डवैः सह। शान्ति लब्धास्मि तेषां वा रणे गन्ता सलोकताम्॥
en: That I will either obtain peace of mind by destroying the Panchalas together with the Pandavas or I will depart to the regions where they (i.e., my) friends have gone by being myself slain in battle.

sa: व्यस्फारयद् वै गाण्डीव सुमहद् भैरवारवम्॥ घोरवज्रविनिष्पेषं स्तनयित्नुरिवाम्बरे।
en: The awful sound made by his out-stretched Gandiva was like the clash of thunder amidst the gloomy clouds.

sa: रथेभ्यः प्रपतन्त्येते रथिनो विगतासवः॥ नानावणैर्हता बाणैः पञ्चालैरपलायिभिः।
en: Car-warriors, deprived of their life, are dropping down from cars, killed by the unretreating Panchalas with variegated arrows.

sa: महावने दारूमये प्रदीप्ते यथा प्रभा भास्करस्यापि नश्येत्। तथा तदाऽऽसीद् ध्वजिनी प्रदीप्ता महाभया भारत भीमरूपा॥
en: On that dreadful night that army blazed up (by the light of those lamps) looked as terrible as the splendour of the sun during the progress of the conflagration of a great forest teeming with trees.

sa: यथा हि कृष्णेन बलं धार्यं वै फाल्गुने हते॥ तथा कर्णात्ययीभावे त्वया धार्यं महद् बलम्।
en: Even as, indeed, the whole force (belonging to the Pandavas) is supported by Krishna upon the fall of Phalguna, so should this vast army (of the Kurus) be supported by you upon the death of Karna.

sa: जानाति तं पाण्डव एष चापि पापं लोके कर्णमसामन्यैः। ततस्त्वमुक्तो भृशरोषितेन राज्ञा समक्षं परुषाणि पार्थ॥
en: O Partha, the king believes that this immoral Karna is unbearable to everyone else on earth but you. It was this that enraged him so highly as to use such cruel words even in your face.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज सेनापतिरमर्षणः॥ निशितेनातिबाणेन द्रौणिहं विव्याध पार्षतः।
en: Having said this, O king, the revengeful commander (of Pandava's army) Parshata struck Drona's son with sharpened arrows.

sa: उत्तमौजा हताश्वस्तु हतसूतश्च संयुगे। आरुरोह रथं भ्रातुर्युधामन्योरभित्वरन्॥
en: Having his horses and his charioteer stain, Uttamoujas ascended the car of his brother Yudhamanyu with great celerity.

sa: गिरयः सागराश्चैव नद्यश्च सजलास्तथा॥ वृक्षाश्चौषधयश्चैव व्याश्रयन्त किरीटिनम्।
en: O foremost of men, all the mountains, rivers, seas, with trees, herbs and plants were for crowned Arjuna.

sa: किरशरगणान् राजन् नरवारणवाजिषु॥ वध्यमाना महाराज पाण्डवेन यशस्विना।
en: Discharging numerous arrows, O king, at men, elephants and horses. O mighty monarch, slaughtered by that renowned Pandava.

sa: क्लिश्यमानेषु सैन्येषु वध्यमानेषु राजसु। अमर्षवशमापन्नाः पञ्चाला विमुखाऽभवन्॥
en: Their troops fatigued and their kings slain, the Panchalas although burning with rage, were compelled to turn back.

sa: शरवर्षाणि घोराणि मेघाविव परस्परम्। सौमदत्तिस्तु शैनेयं प्रच्छायेषुभिराशुगैः॥
en: On each other, dreadful showers of arrows like two mighty-clouds. Covering Sini's grandson with swift-coursing arrows, Somadatta's son.

sa: कर्णोऽपि भीमसेनस्य निवार्येषून् महाबलः। प्राहिणोन्नव नाराचानाशीविषसमान् रणे॥
en: Karna also, that mighty hero, baffling Bhima's darts, wounded Bhima with nine Narachas resembling snakes of virulent venom.

sa: अथान्यैः सप्तदशभिर्भल्लैः कनकभूषणैः। धृष्टद्युम्नं मसासाद्य बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then approaching Dhristadyumna he struck him on the breast and two arms with seventeen other gold winged arrows.

sa: पाण्डवा लब्धलक्ष्याश्च धनंजयपुरोगमाः। त्वामेवाभिमुखाः शूरा युद्धाय समुपस्थिताः॥
en: Those brave warriors, the Pandavas who never miss their aim, are coming forward to meet you in fight.

sa: ततस्तान् सायकांस्तत्र द्रोणनुन्नान् सहस्रशः॥ चिच्छेद समरे वीरस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
en: Then all those arrows shot by thousands by Drona that hero cut-off in battle. Indeed this looked wonderful.

sa: इदं महत् त्वय्युपपद्यते प्रभो रणाजिरे कर्म यशोभिवर्धनम्। शतक्रतौ चापि स देवसत्तमे महाहवे जनुषि दैत्यदानवान्॥
en: O lord, that foremost of the celestials, the performer of a hundred sacrifices who slay in great battle the Daytas and the Danavas and yourself only are capable of achieving such a fame-enhancing and glorious feat.

sa: तथैव शक्रप्रतिमोऽपि सात्यकिः सुदर्शने यान् क्षिपति स्म सायकान्। द्विधा त्रिधा तानकरोत् सुदर्शन: शरोत्तमैः स्यन्दनवर्यमास्थितः॥
en: So also did, Sudarsana, riding on his own chariot of excellent make, severed, by means of his own arrows, in two or three parts, all the arrows sped at him by Satyaki who resembled Indra himself.

sa: किरीटिनं प्रविव्याध शरेणानतपर्वणा। जत्रुदेशे नरव्याघ्र प्रहसन् बभ्रुवाहनः॥
en: Then Babhruvahana, laughing, cut the diadem-decked Arjuna, that foremost of men, in the shoulder with a straight arrow.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा गोविन्दो धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्। विरराम महातेजास्तमुवाच युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Having said this to Yudhishthira, prince of the pious, the high-spirited Govinda stopped; and Yudhishthira answered him thus.

sa: तथैव च स राजर्षिस्तथौ तां रजनीं तदा। सभार्यो वाग्यत: श्रीमान् न च कोपं समाविशत्।।२४
en: The royal sage Kushika thereupon stood there in the same posture for the whole night, with his wife by his side, and without speaking a word. Gifted with great prosperity, he did not yield to wrath.

sa: असुराश्च सुराश्चैव पुण्यहेतोर्मखक्रियाम्। प्रयतन्ते महात्मानस्तस्माद् यज्ञाः परायणम्॥
en: The great celestials and Asuras celebrate sacrifices for acquiring religious mcrit; and therefore sacrifices are of great importance.

sa: राक्षसाश्च ददुस्तस्मै वराहमहिषावभौ। कुक्वुटं चाग्निसंकाशं प्रददावरुणः स्वयम्॥
en: The Rakshasas gave to him a boar and a buffalo. Aruna himself gave him cock of fiery splendour.

sa: ते तु लोकाः सहस्राक्ष शृणु यादृग्गुणान्विताः। न तत्र क्रमते कालो न जरा न च पावकः॥ तथा नास्त्यशुभं किंचिन्न व्याधिस्तत्र न क्रमः।
en: O you, of a thousand eyes, hear me as I tell you what the attributes are of those regions. There the very course of Time is stopped. Decrepitude is not there nor Fire which is omnipresent in the universe. There is slightest transgression does not take place, nor disease, nor weakness of any sort.

sa: ततः पीत्वा बलभित् सोममयं ये चाप्यन्ये सोमपा देवसंघाः। सर्वेऽनुज्ञाताः प्रययुः पार्थिवेन यथाजोषं तर्पिताः प्रीतिमन्तः॥
en: And then the Destroyer of Vala first drank the Soma juice, and then the assembly of other celestials who drank Soma, and then in happiness and with the king's permission they returned home well-pleased and delighted.

sa: ये च क्रीणन्ति दासी च विक्रीणन्ति तथैव च। भवेत् तेषां तथा निष्ठा लुब्धानां पापचेतसाम्॥
en: Only those sinful persons who possessed besides, by cupidity, and who sell and purchase female slaves for making them servants, consider the relation of wife as capable of originating from the gift and acceptance of dower.

sa: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच इमां भूमिं द्विजातिभ्यो दित्सुवै दक्षिणां पुरा। अङ्गो नाम नृपो राजंस्ततश्चिन्तां मही ययौ॥
en: The god of wind said Once on a time, O king, a king named Anga wished to give away the entire Earth as sacrificial present to the Brahmanas. At this, the Earth became stricken with anxiety.

sa: वासुदवोऽथ दाशार्हो बलदेवः ससात्यकिः। अभिमन्योस्तदा श्राद्धमकुर्वन् सत्यकस्तदा॥
en: Then Vasudeva of Dasharha's race, and Baladeva, and Satyaki, and Satyaka, each performed the obsequial rites of Abhimanyu.

sa: उत्पपात तदा वह्वौ ववृधे चाद्भुतोपमम्। तेजस्तेजसि संयुक्तमात्मयोनित्वमागतम्॥
en: That seed, falling on the Earth, leaped into a burning fire and there began to grow most wonderfully.

sa: अतिवादोऽतितिक्षा च मात्सर्यमभिमानिता। अश्रद्दधानता चैव तामसं वृत्तमिष्यते॥
en: Indulgence in calumny, unforgiveness, animosity, vanity, and absence of faith are also said to be characteristic of Ignorance.

sa: उमोवाच देशेषु रमणीयेषु नदीनां निझरेषु च। स्रवन्तीनां निकुञ्जेषु पर्वतेषु वनेषु च॥ देशेषु च पवित्रेषु फलवस्तु समाहिताः। मूलवत्सु च मध्येषु वसन्ति नियतव्रताः॥
en: Uma said Hermits live in charming regions, among the springs and fountains of rivers, in bowers by the sides of rivers and rills, on hills and mountains, in woods and forests, and in sacred places full of fruits and roots. With rapt attention and observing vows and rules, they live in even such places.

sa: अहन्यहनि यो दद्यात् कपिला द्वादशीः समाः। मासि मासि च सत्रेण यो यजेत सदा नरः॥ गवां शतसहस्रं च यो दद्याज्ज्येष्ठपुष्करे। न तद्धर्मफलं तुल्यमतिथिर्यस्य तुष्यति॥
en: The merits acquired by a person who gives way a Kapila cow every day for twelve years, or by a person who worships the deities every month in a sacrifice or by him who gives away hundreds of thousands o kine in the great Pushkara, do not equal those that are his with whom a guest is pleased. now

sa: त्वय्यद्य पिण्डः कीर्तिश्च कुलं चेदं प्रतिष्ठितम्। श्वो वाद्य वा महाबाहो गम्यतां पुत्र मा चिरम्॥
en: The obsequial cake, the fame and achievements, and the family of our ancestors, now depend upon you entirely. O mightyarmed one, do you then go either to-morrow or this very day. Do not tarry. O son.

sa: ऋषयो धर्मनित्यास्तु कृत्वा निवपनान्युत। तर्पणं चाप्यकुर्वन्त तीर्थाम्भोभिर्यतव्रताः॥
en: Performing all duties, the Rishis, having performed Shraddhas, began to also offer oblations of sacred waters, with attention.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच राजस्तथेह कर्तास्मि पुनरेष्यामि ते वशम्। प्रश्नं च कंचित् प्रष्टु त्वां निवृत्तेऽस्मि परंतप॥
en: Utanka said O king, I shall certainly carry out my promise. I shall truly return and place myself under your power. There is, however, a question, O scorcher of enemies which I wish to ask you.

sa: ततस्ते यातुधानी तां दृष्ट्वा विकृतदर्शनाम्। स्थितां कमलिनीतीरे कृत्यामूचुर्महर्षयः॥ एका तिष्ठसि का च त्वं कस्यार्थे किं प्रयोजनम्। पद्मिनीतीरमाश्रित्य ब्रूहि त्वं किं चिकीर्षसि॥
en: Seeing Yatudhani of fearful aspect standing on the banks of the lake, those great Rishis addressed her, saying Who are you who thus stand alone in this solitary forest? For whom do you wait here? What indeed, is your purpose? What do you do here on the banks of this lake adorned with lotuses?

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। वृषादर्भश्च संवादं सप्तर्षीणां च भारत॥
en: Regarding it is cited an old history of the conversation between Vrishadarbhi and the seven Rishis, O Bharata.

sa: शम्बर उवाच नासूयामि यदा विप्रान् ब्राह्ममेव च मे मतम्। शास्त्राणि वदतो विप्रान् सम्मन्यामि यथासुखम्॥
en: Shambara said I never entertain any ill feelings towards the Brahmanas. Whatever instructions they give, I accept with unqualified reverence. When the Brahmanas are engaged in explaining the scriptures, I listen to them with great happiness.

sa: अथाग्निर्देवता दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथितस्तदा। किमागमनमित्येवं तानपृच्छत पावकः॥
en: Meanwhile Agni, seeing the gods, became grieved. Addressing the celestials, he asked them, Why have you come here?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच आहूयमानश्च स तेन संख्ये महात्मना वै धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रः। निवर्तितस्तस्य गिराङ्कुशेन महागजो मत्त इवाङ्कुशेन॥
en: Vaishampayana said-"O Janamejaya! Duryodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra again returned like an intoxicant elephant injured by goad when great Arjuna challenged him so far the bathe as his harsh words acted like a goad on him.

sa: गिरिं य इच्छेत् तु तलेन भेत्तुं शिलोच्चयं श्वेतमतिप्रमाणम्। न चापि किंचित् स गिरेस्तु कुर्यात्॥
en: He, who desires to pierce by the palm of his hand the high white mountain of huge dimensions, has his hand with his nails only wasted away; and absolutely no harm is done to the mountain.

sa: तेऽसृजन् सर्वभूतानि त्रसानि स्थावराणि च। यक्षराक्षसभूतानि पिशाचोरगमानुषान्॥
en: They also seeing the same thing created Yakshas, Rakshasas, Pishachas, reptiles, men and all mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: न वेदानां वेदितां कश्चिदस्ति वेद्येन वेदं न विदुर्न वेद्यम्। यो वेद वेदं स च वेद वेद्यं यो वेद वेद्यं न स वेद सत्यम्॥
en: Among the faculties of the mind there is none which can help us in obtaining a true knowledge of self. There is none, again, who by means of the mind alone can acquire a knowledge of the knowable Being. He who knows what self is knows what self is not. He who stands on Truth knows the Supreme Soul.

sa: विध्यन्तो मृगजातानि महेष्वासा महाबलाः। उत्तरेण दशार्णांस्ते पञ्चालान् दक्षिणेन च॥ अन्तरेण यकृल्लोमान् शूरसेनांश्च पाण्डवाः। लुब्धा ब्रुवाणा मत्स्यस्य विषयं प्राविशन् वनात्॥ धन्विनो बद्धनिस्त्रिंशा विवर्णाः श्मश्रुधारिणः। ततो जनपदं प्राप्य कृष्णा राजानमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having put an end to their forest life, those sons of Pandu, wielders of great bows, endued with great strength, equipped with swords, wearing beards and looking wan proceeded through Yakrilloma and and Shurasena, and leaving the country of Panchalas on the south and that of Dasharna on the north, dwelling (sometimes) in hill-forts and forest fastness and killing the deer (in their journey) entered Matsya's dominions giving out themselves as hunters.

sa: सुवर्णपत्राश्च पतन्ति पश्चाद् दृष्ट्वा रथं श्वेतहयप्रयुक्तम्। अहं ह्येकः पार्थिवान् सर्वयोधान् शरान् वर्षन् मृत्युलोकं नयेयम्॥
en: Also birds, having golden feathers, come down and having seen my chariot with white steeds follow it. I alone unaided can send to the regions of death all the rulers and warriors by showing my arrows.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुर्दिव्यमैन्द्रं महारथः। अस्त्रमादित्यसंकाशं गाण्डीवे समयोजयत॥
en: Then smiling, the mighty car-warrior Bibhatsu set the Aindra weapon, effulgent like the sun, on his Gandiva bow.

sa: प्रमादाद् वै असुराः पराभवनप्रमादाद ब्रह्मभूताः भवन्ति। नैव मृत्युर्व्याघ्र इवात्ति जन्तून् न ह्यस्य रूपमुपलभ्यते हि॥
en: From ignorance do the Asuras become subject (to death); and from the reverse of ignorance do they attain to the conditions of Brahma. Death does not destroy animals like a tiger; its shape cannot be known.

sa: स त्वं याचात्र राजानं कंचिद् राजर्षिवंशजम्। अपीड्य राजा पौरान् हि यो नौ कुर्यात् कृतार्थिनौ॥
en: Except by wealth there exists possibility of your getting the horses. Such being the case do you ask some king born in some family of royal Rishi who can make us successful without oppressing his subjects.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् प्रीतमना मत्स्यराजो युधिष्ठिरम्। पुनरेव महाबाहुर्विराटो राजसत्तमः॥
en: Then the mighty armed, Virata, the king of Matsya's, the foremost of monarchs, again delightedly said to Yudhishthira.

sa: त्वरमाणस्ततो भृत्यानासनानीत्यचोदयत्। आसनान्यथ मृष्टानि महान्ति विपुलानि च॥
en: Quickly commanded the attendants to get seats soon for them and they brought many spacious and beautiful seats.

sa: तं सभायां महाराजमासीनं राष्ट्रवर्धनम्। सोऽब्रवीदुपसंगम्य विराटं प्रणतस्तदा॥
en: And approaching the great king Virata, the enhancer of kingdom, seated in the court, he, with humility, said.

sa: मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं हत्वा शत्रु सुरारिहा। त्वष्टा प्रजापतिः श्रुत्वा शक्रेणाथं हतं सुतम्॥ क्रोधसंरक्तनयन इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: This chief among the gods, having killed his enemy, thought himself gratified. Tvashtri, the lord of all beings, having heard of the slaying of his son by Shakra, said these words with eyes red with wrath.

sa: सुशिक्षितः कृतवैरस्तरस्वी दहेत् क्षुद्रांस्तरसा धार्तराष्ट्रान्। सदात्यमर्षी न बलात् स शक्यो युद्धे जेतु वासवेनापि माक्षात्॥
en: Well-trained and strong, being rendered an enemy and inspired with worth he would burn down the sons of Dhritarashtra. Being always very wrathful and strong he is incapable of being defeated even by Vasava (Indra) himself.

sa: पञ्चालानामधिपं चैव वृद्धं धृष्टद्युम्नं पार्ष याज्ञसेनिम्। सर्वे वाचं शृणुतेमा मदीयां वक्ष्यामि यां भूतिमिच्छन् कुरूणाम्॥
en: And also to the aged lord of the people of Panchala, Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata and Yagaseni. All of you listen to these words which I speak, being desirous of the welfare of the Kurus.

sa: ततोऽहमामन्त्र्य तदा धनंजयं चतुर्भुजं चैव नमस्य सत्वरः। जवेन सम्प्राप्त इहामराते तवान्तिकं प्रापयितुं वचो महत्॥
en: Then quickly bidding farewell to Dhananjaya and the One with four arms and bowing down to them, have I come here with speed to tell you this great news, O you of the luster of immortals.

sa: द्वेष्यो न साधुर्भवति न मेधावी न पण्डितः। प्रिये शुभानि कार्याणि द्वेष्ये पापानि चैव ह॥
en: He that is despised is not honest, nor intelligent, nor wise (to the man who despises him). To him that is beloved are attributed all good acts and to him that is despised all bad ones.

sa: को ह्येव युष्मान् सह केशवेन सचेकितानान् पार्षतबाहुगुप्तान्। ससात्यकीन् विषहेत प्रजेतुं लध्वाऽपि देवान् सचिवान् सहेन्द्रान्॥
en: Who is capable of withstanding you who are assisted by Keshava, Chekitana and Satyaki and protected by the arms of the son of Prishata even after getting Indra and all his divine followers on his side.

sa: एवं सर्वानागताभ्यागतांश्च राज्ञो दूतान् सर्वदिग्भ्योऽभ्युपेतान्। पृष्ट्वा सर्वान् कुशलं तांश्च सूत पश्चादहं कुशली तेषु वाच्यः॥
en: In the same way all the ambassadors, of the king (Dhritarashtra) who have come there from all directions, should first be asked about their health and afterwards they should be told that I am doing well.

sa: न मर्मगां जादु वक्तासि रूक्षां नोपश्रुतिं कटुकां नोत मुक्ताम्। मेतां वाचं तव जानीम सूत॥
en: You are not a speaker of cutting and rude words, nor of harsh or false words. We are aware that your words are based on the principles of virtue, pregnant with meaning and humane, O Suta.

sa: वयं किरातैः सहिता गच्छामो गिरिमुत्तरम्। ब्राह्मणैर्देवकल्पैश्च विद्याजम्भकवार्तिकैः॥
en: We want to the Northern mountains accompanied by hunters and godlike Brahmanas fond of conversations incantations and medicines.

sa: प्रेक्षमाणा बहुविधान् वनोद्देशान् समन्ततः। यथर्तुकालरम्याश्च वनराजीः सुपुष्पिताः॥
en: Beholding various wild tracts of country on all sides, the woodland decorated with the beautiful, blossming season flowers.

sa: ततस्तु सर्वमालोक्य द्रोणो वचनमब्रवीत्। महारथमनुप्राप्तं दृष्ट्वा गाण्डीवधन्विनम्॥
en: Observing all this and that the great carwarrior, the holder of the Gandiva bow has come, Drona said:

sa: अध:शायी कुम्भकर्णो यताहारो यतव्रतः। विभीषणः शीर्णपर्णमेकमभ्यवहारयन्॥ उपवासरतिर्धीमान् सदा जप्यपरायणः। तमेव कालमातिष्ठत् तीव्र तप उदारधीः॥
en: Lying down on earth and with restricted diet Kumbhakarna was engaged in penances; the wise and noble Vibhishana, fasting and living on dry leaves, engaged in meditation and practised devout penances for as long a period.

sa: अष्टौ दोषाः प्रमादस्य तान् दोषान् परिवर्जयेत्। इन्द्रियेभ्यश्च पञ्चभ्यो मनसश्चैव भारत। अतीतानागतेभ्यश्च मुक्त्युपेतः सुखी भवेत्॥
en: Ignorance of self has eight vices. These vices should be avoided. He who has attained freedom from the five, senses and from desire, O Bharata and from all concern for the past and future becomes happy.

sa: समुपेत्य ततस्तीक्ष्णैर्मृगेन्द्रेण बलीयसा। नारसिंहेन वपुषा दारित: करजैर्भृशम्॥
en: Then approaching him, that king of beasts, half lion, half man, immediately rent him with his sharp claws.

sa: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्। मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्॥
en: This whole universe, deluded by these three qualities, does not know Me, who are beyond them, and undecaying.

sa: भजस्वास्मान् राजपुत्र भजमानान् महाद्युते। न भविष्यति दुर्बुद्धिर्धार्तराष्ट्रोऽत्यमर्षणः॥
en: O prince, O effulgent one, accept us that accept you; the wrathful and foolish Duryodhana will not live.

sa: अन्तराच्छिद्यमानानि शरीराणि शिरांसि च। निपेतुर्दिक्षु सर्वासु गजाश्वरथयोधिनाम्॥
en: In all directions then fell many heads and bodies cut in the middle, of car-warriors, horsemen and elephant-riders.

sa: नारद उवाच मृतं ददानि ते पुत्रं दस्युभिर्निहतं वृथा। उद्धृत्य नरकात् कष्टात् पशुवत् प्रोक्षितं यथा॥
en: Narada said I will once again give you back your son, who was to no purpose slain by the robbers, like an animal immolated in a sacrifice. I shall take him out of the terrible hell.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्तव पौत्रस्तु सौभद्रं समवस्थितम्। अभ्यवर्तत संहृष्टस्ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Your grandson Lakshmana then rushed at Subhadra's son in anger, and a fearful battle began between the two.

sa: ततः पुनरमेयात्मा भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। शरैः प्रच्छादयामास धृष्टद्युम्नममर्षणम्॥
en: Thereupon the greatly powerful and high souled son of Bharadvaja (Drona) covered with his arrows the angry Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: तमब्रवीन्महाराज भीष्मः शान्तनवः पुनः। माहात्म्यं ते श्रुतं राजन् केशवस्य महात्मनः॥ नरस्य च यथातत्त्वं यन्मां त्वं पृच्छसे नृप। यदर्थं नृषु सम्भूतौ नरनारायणावृषी॥
en: Thereafter, O monarch, Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, again addressed him saying-"You have now heard, o monarch, the true description of the glory of the high-souled Keshava and of Nara, about which you asked me. You have also heard of the purpose for which both Nara and Narayana have taken their births among men.

sa: उद्भूतं सहसा भौमं नागाश्वरथपत्तिभिः। दिवाकररथं प्राप्य रजस्तीव्रमदृश्यत॥
en: Then a thick shower of dust, being raised by foot-soldiers, horses and cars and cavalrymen, covered the sky.

sa: प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते। प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते॥
en: Peace being attained, all his miseries are destroyed. He, whose mind has attained to peace, soon becomes steady.

sa: धर्मराजस्ततस्तूर्णमभिगम्य जनार्दनम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः सर्वैश्चैव जनेश्वरैः॥
en: Dharmaraja Yudhishthira soon went to Janardana with all his brothers and with all the kings of his side.

sa: सेनापतिरमेयात्मा धृष्टद्युम्नो महाबलः। द्रोणेन समरे राजन् समियायोचकर्मणा॥
en: Then, O king the mighty car-warriors, that generalissimo Dhrishtadyumna of immeasurable soul, engaged with Drona of fierce achievements.

sa: पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान् हत्वैतानाततायिनः॥ तस्मानार्दा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान् स्वबान्धवान्। स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव॥
en: Even killing these felons, we shall incur sin. Therefore, it is not proper that we shall kill our own kinsmen, these sons of Dhritarashtra. How can we, O Madhava, be happy by killing our own relatives?

sa: ध्रुवमास्थाय बीभूत्सुरुत्तमास्त्राणि संयुगे। अपास्यान्यान् रणे योधानभ्येष्यति पितामहम्॥
en: Surely Vibhatsu will, with the help of his excellent weapons, leaving, other warriors in battle, confront the grandsire.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पौरुषम्। यदेकः समरे वीरस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: But we then saw the great prowess of Dhrishtadyumna. He stood immovable like a mountain in that battle.

sa: ततः शतसहस्राणि योधानामनिवर्तिनाम्। व्यवस्थितानि सर्वाणि शकटे मुखरक्षिणाम्॥
en: Nex, to them were placed hundreds and thousands of unretreating warriors, for protecting the head of that array.

sa: अनुलोमः सुगन्धी च पृषतैश्च समन्वितः॥ देवदुन्दुभयश्चैव सम्प्रणेदुर्महास्वनाः।
en: Fragrant and moistened with sprinkles of water, from all directions. Celestial drums were also sounded emitting great din.

sa: मुक्तावज्रमणिस्वर्णभूषितं तदयस्मयम्। वरूथं विबभौ तस्य ज्योतिर्भिः खमिवावृतम्॥
en: His iron-made car-fence embossed with pearls, diamonds and gold, appeared effulgent like the welkin bespangled with the luminaries.

sa: ततोऽन्यान् षट् समादाय श्वेतोहेमविभूषितान्। तेषां षण्णां महाबाहुर्ध्वजशीर्षाण्यपातयत्॥
en: Then taking up six other arrows decked with gold, Shveta cut off the standards of his six adversaries.

sa: आर्जवेनागतं दृष्ट्वा राजपुत्रं शिखण्डिनम्। सर्वमेव यथावृत्ताचचक्षे शिखण्डिने॥
en: Seeing that prince Shikhandin come to him without guile, he related to Shikhandin everything as it had happened.

sa: पाण्डवाश्च महाराज भीमसेनपुरोगमाः। साधु साध्विति नादेन पृथिवीमन्वनादयन्॥
en: The Pandavas also, O mighty monarch, headed by Bhimasena filled the earth with their shouts of 'well-done' 'well-done'.

sa: उत्थितान्यगणेयानि कबन्धानि समन्ततः। अदृश्यन्त महाराज तस्मिन् परमसंकुले॥
en: In that dreadful carnage, 0 mighty monarch, innumerable headless trunks were seen to stand up on all sides.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवानां महारथाः। अभ्यवर्तन्त वेगेन भीमसेनपुरोगमाः॥
en: Beholding that elephant thus advance furiously, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host headed by Bhima assaulted it.

sa: अक्षय्याविषुधी चैव अग्निदत्तं च ते रथम्। जानीमो हि रणे पार्थं केतुं दिव्यं च भारत॥
en: I know that your quivers are exhausted of their contents. I know your chariot given to you by Agni. I know you, O son of Pritha, in battle and I know your celestial banners, O Bharata.

sa: वैदूर्यमणिदण्डैश्च पतितैरङ्कुशैः शुभैः। घण्डाभिश्च गजेन्द्राणां पतिताभिः समन्ततः॥
en: With well-shaped hooks having their handles decked with lapses, with bells of huge elephants scattered here and there.

sa: ततोऽहमानुपूर्येण दिव्यान्यस्त्राण्ययोजयम्। ततस्तानि सहस्राणि रथिनां चित्रयोधिनाम्॥ अस्त्राणि मम दिव्यानि प्रत्यघ्नन् शनकैरिव। रथमार्गान् विचित्रांस्ते विचरन्तो महाबलाः॥ प्रत्यदृश्यन्त संचामे शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। विचित्रमुकुटापीडा विचित्रकवचध्वजाः॥
en: I took to discharging duly the celestials weapons. But the thousands of weapons, discharged by those car-warriors, the wonderful fighters, gradually repelled my celestials weapons, and I beheld hundreds and thousands of exceedingly powerful (Danavas) ranging on their cars, in battle, displaying various tactics. Adorned with variegated helmets ornamented mails, furnished with beautiful flags.

sa: ततः समस्तानि किरीटमाली वनेषु वृत्तानि गदाचजाय। उक्त्वा यथावत् पुनरन्वपृच्छत् कथं सुभद्रां च स चाभिमन्युः॥
en: Then he who wore a coronet on his head (Arjuna) having related in detail to the elder brother of Gada (Krishna) all the incidents in connection with their forest life asked how are Subhadra and Abhimanyu?

sa: तव चाप्यरतिस्तीता वर्तते तमपश्यतः। गुडाकेशं महात्मानं संग्रामेष्वपलायिनम्॥
en: Your dejection also is very great at not seeing the high-souled Gudukesha (Arjuna) who never retreats from battle.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र प्रभासं तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र संनिहितो नित्यं स्वयमेव हुताशनः॥ देवतानां मुखं वीर ज्वलनोऽनिलसारथिः।
en: O King of kings, thence one should go to that excellent Tirtha called Pravasha; Hutashana (Agni) himself is always present there. O hero, he is the mouth of the celestials and has wind for his chariot.

sa: एतत प्लक्षावतरणं यमुनातीर्थमुत्तमम्। एतद् वै नाकपृष्ठस्य द्वारमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: This is Plakshavatarana, an excellent tirtha in the Yamuna. The learned men call it the gate of heaven.

sa: तान् प्रस्थितान् प्रीतमना महर्षिः पितेव पुत्राननुशिष्य सर्वान्। स लोमशः प्रीतमना जगाम दिवौकसां पुण्यतमं निवासम्॥
en: (And) when they were about to start (on their journey) the great sage, Lomasha, gave them instructions as a father gives to his own sons and then went to the most sacred region of the celestials.

sa: विद्याधरसमाकीर्णान् युतान् वानरकिन्नरैः। तथा किंपुरुषैश्चैव गन्धर्वैश्च समन्ततः॥
en: Thronged with Vidyadharas, abounding on all sides in the monkeys and the Kinnaras, the Kimpurushas and the Gandharvas,

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच त्रयोदशाहानि ससार केशी त्रयोदशादीन्यतिच्छन्दांसि चाहुः॥
en: Ashtavakra said: Thirteen sacrifices are presided over by Keshi and thirteen are devoured by Atichandas of the Vedas.

sa: यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वास्तथैव च पतत्रिणः। खेचराणि च भूतानि सर्वाण्येवावतस्थिरे॥
en: The Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Gandharvas, the feathery creatures, the skyranging creatures-all these beings appeared (on the scene).

sa: प्राकारेण परिक्षिप्तं सौवर्णेन समन्ततः। सर्वरत्नद्युतिमता सर्वोद्यानवता तथा॥
en: Encircled on all sides by golden walls, having the lustre of all gems, containing gardens of all sorts,

sa: यमात् कुबेराद् वरुणादिन्द्राच्च कुरुनन्दन। अस्त्राण्यधीतवान् पार्थो दिव्यान्यमितविक्रमः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, have been obtained by the immeasurably powerful Partha from Yama, Kubera, Varuna and Indra.

sa: द्वारं सुघोरं नरकस्य जिह्यं न बुध्यते धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रः। तमन्वेतारो बहवः कुरूणां द्यूतोदये सह दुःशासनेन॥
en: The son of Dhritarashtra does not know that dishonesty is one of the fearful doors of hell. Many Kurus with Dushasana amongst them have followed him in the path of dishonesty in this play at dice.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच स्तथास्त्विति प्राह कुरुप्रवीर। ततः स राजा मुदितो बभूव वाम्यौ चास्मै प्रददौ सम्प्रणम्य॥
en: Markandeya said : Having heard her these words, O foremost of the Kurus, the Rishi said, “Be it so." Thereupon that king, becoming exceedingly happy and bowing to the great Rishi, gave him his Vami horses.

sa: वित्रस्ता दैत्यनार्यस्ताः स्वानि वेश्मान्यथाविशन्। बहुरलविचित्राणि शातकुम्भमयानि च॥
en: At last the affrighted ladies of the Daityas entered into their respective golden palaces decked with innumerable gems.

sa: विस्मयः सुमहानासीन्मधुकैटभयोस्तथा। दृष्ट्वा पितामहं चापि पद्म पद्मनिभेक्षणम्॥ वित्रासयेतामथ तौ ब्रह्माणममितौजसम्। वित्रस्यमानो बहुशो ब्रह्मा ताभ्यां महायशाः॥ अकम्पयत् पद्मनालं ततोऽबुध्यत केशवः। अथापश्यत गोविन्दो दानवौ वीर्यवत्तरौ॥
en: Madhu and Kaitabha became greatly astonished on seeing the lotus-eyed Grandsire sitting on the lotus. They then began to terrify Brahma of immeasurable prowess. The illustrious Brahma, frightened by them, began to tremble on his seat. At his trembling, the stalk of the lotus began to tremble and thus Keshava awoke and he saw those two greatly effulgent Danavas.

sa: स्निग्धपत्रैरविरलैः शीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः। सरांसि च विचित्राणि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च॥
en: With glossy and beautiful foliage, with cool shade and with beautiful loveliness, with various lakes of crystal waters,

sa: अपश्यन्त हयं तत्र विचरन्तं महीतले। कपिलं च महात्मानं तेजोराशिमनुत्तमम्। तेजसा दीप्यमानं तु ज्वालाभिरिव पावकम्॥
en: They then saw that the horse was roaming there on the surface of the ground. (They also saw) the illustrious Kapila, a perfect mass of great effulgence. He was blazing in splendour like a blazing fire.

sa: ततः शक्तिं महाधोरां रुक्मदण्डामयस्मयीम्। तस्मिन्नेवान्तरेधीमान् प्रजहाराथ राक्षसः॥
en: At this interval, that intelligent Rakshasa assailed (Bhima) with a dreadful iron club furnished with a golden handle.

sa: तदत्रिया॑यतः सर्वं प्रतिगृह्याभिसत्कृतः। प्रत्युज्जगाम तेजस्वी गृहानेव महातपाः॥
en: And the energetic Atri, thus honored by the king and having rightfully accepted all the wealth returned home.

sa: स्वकर्म कुरु मा ग्लासी: कर्मणा भव दंशितः। कृतं हि योऽभिजानाति सहस्रे सोऽस्ति नास्ति च॥
en: You should therefore act and never incur censure by leaving affection; cover yourself with action as with an armour. There might not be one in a thousand who does not truly understand the utility of work.

sa: एवमाभाष्य तान् सर्वानभ्यवर्तत राक्षसः। शक्तिशूलगदापाणिरभ्यधावत् स पाण्डवम्॥
en: Having addressed them thus, that Rakshasa, holding in the hands, clubs, javelins and maces, rushed against the Pandava.

sa: बन्धुवाच स्तत्रास सत्रं द्वादशवार्षिकं वै। सत्रेण ते जनक तुल्यकालं तदर्थं ते प्रहिता मे द्विजाच्याः॥
en: O Janaka, I am the son of king Varuna. Simultaneously with your sacrifice, there (underneath the sea) has been commenced (by Varuna) a sacrifice extending over twelve years. Therefore I have sent there those chief Brahmanas.

sa: अतः प्रियं चेतदनुकाक्षसे त्वं सर्वेषु कार्येषु हिताहितेषु। स्त्रियश्च राजञ्जडपङ्गुकांच पृच्छ त्वं वै तादृशांश्चैव सर्वान्॥
en: O king, if you hereafter wish to hear words that are agreeable to you as regards all good or bad acts, you should ask (for it to) women, idiots, cripples or all persons of such descriptions.

sa: यवक्रीस्तामुवाचेदमुपातिष्ठस्व मामिति। निर्लज्जो लज्जया युक्तां कामेन हतचेतनः॥
en: Having lost his sense through desire, he shamelessly spoke to that bashful maiden saying, “Be attached to me."

sa: राजोवाच न त्वां मन्ये मानुषं देवसत्त्वं न त्वं बाल: स्थविरः सम्मतो मे। न ते तुल्यो विद्यते वाक्प्रलापे तस्माद् द्वारं वितराम्येष बन्दी॥
en: The King said : Opossessor of divine energy, it appears that you are not a human being. I do not consider that you are a boy. I consider you to be a grown up man. There is none who can be compared with you in learning. Therefore I give you admittance. Yonder is Bandi.

sa: सिद्धिर्वाप्यथवासिद्धिरप्रवृत्तिरतोऽन्यथा। बहूनां समवाये हि भावानां कर्म सिद्ध्यति॥
en: Success or failure, no one should despair, for success in action depends upon the union of many circumstances.

sa: सभेयं मे बहुरत्ना विचित्रा शय्यासनैरुपपन्ना महाहैः। सा दृश्यतां भ्रातृभिः सार्धमेत्य सुहृद्यूतं वर्ततामत्र चेति॥ :।
en: Coming here with his brothers, let him see my this beautiful Assembly-hall furnished with countless gems and jewels and with costly beds and carpets. Let then a friendly match at dice by played in that Hall."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा ब्रुवन्ती करुणं सुमध्यमा भर्तृन् कटाक्षैः कुपितानपश्यत्। सा पाण्डवान् कोपपरीतदेहान् संदीपयामास कटाक्षपातैः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The slender-waisted (Draupadi) thus cried in distress in that Sabha and cast a glance on her enraged husbands, the Pandavas, who were filled with fearful wrath. She inflamed them more by her that glance.

sa: यमस्यधातुः सवितुस्त्वष्टुर्वैश्रवणस्य च। तानि प्राप्य सहस्राक्षादभिवाद्य शतक्रतुम्॥
en: Yama, Dhata, Savita, Tashta and Vaisravana and getting these weapons, paying homage to the performer of hundred sacrifices.

sa: तां चाथ दृष्टवा नलिनी विशोकाः पाण्डोः सुताः सर्वनरप्रधानाः। ते रेमिरे नन्दनवासमेत्य द्विजर्षयो वीतमला यथैव॥
en: (And) seeing that lake, those sons of Pandu, the best of all men, devoid of sorrow, began to sport there, (just) as the sinless Brahmana sages do on getting a habitation in the garden of Nandana.

sa: पत्रिणः पुष्पितानेतान् संपतन्नि महाद्दुमान्। रक्तपीतारुणाः पार्थ पादपाग्रगताः खगाः॥ परस्परमुदीक्षन्ते बहवो जीवजीवकाः। हरितारुणवर्णानां शाद्वलानां समीपतः॥
en: Birds alighting these great blossoming trees. O Partha, seated on the boughs these myriad of Yivajevaka birds of scarlet, yellow and red colour are looking at one another. And near the green and red grass plots,

sa: कुमारास्ते विशाखं च पितृत्वे समकल्पयन्। स भूत्वा भगवान् संख्ये रक्षश्छागमुखस्तदा॥ वृतः कन्यागणैः सर्वैरात्मीयैः सह पुत्रकैः। मातृणां प्रेक्षमाणानां भद्रशाखश्च कौसलः॥ ततः कुमारपितरं स्कन्दमाहुर्जना भुवि। रुद्रमग्निमुमां स्वाहां प्रदेशेषु महाबलाम्॥ यजन्ति पुत्रकामाश्च पुत्रिणश्च सदा जनाः। यास्तास्त्वजनयत् कन्यास्तपो नाम हुताशनः॥ किं करोमीति ताः स्कन्दं सम्प्राप्ताः समभाषयन्।
en: These children adopted Visakha as their father. That adorable and clever Bhadrasakha, with a face like that of a goat, was at the time surrounded by all his sons and daughters whom he guarded carefully in the presence of the great mothers. For this reason the dwellers of earth called Skanda the father of Kumaras. Those who desire to have sons worship the mighty Rudra in the form of the fire-god and Uma in the form of Svaha. By this means they are blessed with sons. The daughters, begotten by Hutasana named Tapa. Having gone to Skanda, were thus addressed by him, 'What can I do for you?'

sa: यदा चायं न बिभेति यदा चास्मात बिभ्यति। यदा नेच्छति न देशि ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When one entertains no fear of anything, when one is not feared by anything when one entertains no desire, when one bears no hate, then is one said to have attained to the dignity of Brahma.
