sa: स च्छिन्नं मुसलं दृष्ट्वा द्रौणिः परमकोपनः॥ आददे परिघं घोरं नगेन्द्रिशिखरोपमम्। चिक्षेप चैव पार्थाय द्रौणियुद्धविशारदः॥
en: Seeing his mallet cut off, Drona's son, in great anger, took up a terrible mace adorned with iron spikes and looking like a mountain crest. Accomplished in warfare, the son of Drona discharged it at Partha.

sa: भीमसेनोऽथ बलवान् पुत्रस्तव जनाधिप।॥ तथैव चोद्यतगदौ पूजयामासर्तुबलम्।
en: Bhimasena of great strength and your son, O monarch, both with uplifted maces in their arms, adored Baladeva.

sa: उलूकस्तु महेष्वासं नकुलं युद्धदुर्मदम्॥ अभ्यद्रवदमेयात्मा शरवर्षेः समन्ततः।
en: Heroic Uluka rushed against the mighty bowman Nakula, in that battle, discharging showers of arrows from all sides.

sa: बाहूरुचरणानन्यान् विशिखोन्मथितान् पृथक्। संदधत्योऽसुखाविष्टा मूर्च्छन्त्येताः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Other, uniting arms and thighs and feet, cut off with arrows, are grieving and losing their consciousness repeatedly.

sa: तथा तेजोमरीचिभ्यः शङ्खचक्रगदाधराः। प्रादुरासन हषीकेशा: शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: From those blazing flames hundreds and thousands of Hrishikeshas came out armed with conchs and discs and maces.

sa: स यज्ञशीलः प्रजने निविष्टः प्रारब्रह्मचारी प्रविविक्तचक्षुः। आराधयेत् स्वर्गमिमं च लोकं परं च मुक्त्वा हृदयव्यलीकम्॥
en: Celebrating sacrifices and engaged in begetting (children),. after having first observed the vow of Brahmacharya, one who has eyes of wisdom shaking off all anxiety of heart, should seek heaven, this world, and his own soul.

sa: ततो गाण्डीवधन्वानमभ्यभाषत केशवः। स्थितः प्रियहिते नित्यमतीव भरतर्षभ।॥ अवरोपय गाण्डीवमक्षयौ च महेषुधी। अथाहमवरोक्ष्यामि पश्चाद् भरतसत्तम।॥
en: Ever engaged, in the good of his friend, Keshava, addressed the holder of Gandiva, saying, "Take down your Gandiva as also the two inexhaustible quivers. I shall get down after you, O best of the Bharatas.

sa: श्येनवद् विचरन् भीमो गदाहस्तो महाबलः। पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्रास्तावकान् समयोथयत्॥
en: Armed with his mace the powerful Bhima moved about like hawk and killed those twenty five thousand warriors.

sa: यया मायामयान् दृप्तान् सुबहून् धनदालये। जघान गुह्यकान् क्रुद्धो नदन् पार्थो महाबलः॥ निवार्यमाणो बहुभिद्रौपद्याः प्रियमास्थितः।
en: With this weapon Bhima, though resisted by many, had in anger killed a large number of proud Guhyakas endued with powers of illusion on the mount Gandhamadana for the sake of procuring Mandara flowers for Draupadi.

sa: व्याधिरग्निर्जलं शस्त्रं बुभुक्षाश्चापदो विषम्। ज्वरच मरणं जन्तोरुच्चाच्च पतनं तथा॥ निर्माणे यस्य यद् दिष्टं तेन गच्छति सेतुना। दृश्यते नाप्यतिक्रामन्न निष्क्रान्तोऽथवा पुनः॥ दृश्यते चाप्यतिक्रामन्ननिग्राह्योऽथवा पुनः।
en: The dangers of ailment, fire, water, weapons, hunger, poison, fever, and death, and falls from elevated places, visit a man according to the Destiny under which he is born. It is generally seen in this world, that somebody, without committing any sin, suffers many miseries while another, having committed sins, is not pressed down by the weight of calamity.

sa: इति कालेन सर्वार्थानीप्सितानीप्सितानिह। स्पृशन्ति सर्वभूतानि निमित्तं नोपलभ्यते॥
en: Objects, whether sought for or otherwise, come upon creature in course of Time. No other cause is seen.

sa: तथाप्यप्रियमस्माकं पुत्रस्ते समुपाचरत्। द्रौपद्या यत् सभामध्ये सव्यमूरुमदर्शयत्॥
en: Your son wronged us in many ways. In the court he had shown his left thigh to Draupadi.

sa: असिनैवैकधारेण स्वबुद्ध्या तु विचेष्टितम्। प्रायशोऽवृत्तसम्पन्नाः सततं पर्युपासिताः॥
en: Your own intelligence, like a sharp sword, has cut you. You only sought the company of wicked men,

sa: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु विषमा जायते मही। उज्जहार ततो वैन्यः शिलाजालान् समन्ततः॥ धनुष्कोट्या महाराज तेन शैला विवर्धिताः। स विष्णुना च देवेन शक्रेण विबुधैः सह॥ ऋषिभिश्च प्रजापालैब्राह्मणैश्चाभिषेचितः। तं साक्षात् पृथिवी भेजे रत्नान्यादाय पाण्डव॥
en: In every period of Manu the earth becomes uneven. Vena's son removed the rocks lying all around. O king, with the horn of his bow. By this means the hills and mountains were increased in size. The: Vishnu, and the gods with Indra, and the Rishis, and the Regents of the world, and the Brahmanas, assembled for crowning Prithu. The earth herself, O son of Pandu, came incarnate to him, with a tribute of gems and jewels.

sa: स राजा पुत्रपौत्राणां सम्बन्धिसुहृदां तदा। स्मरन्नुद्विग्नहृदयो बभूवोद्विग्नचेतनः॥
en: Recollecting his sons and grandsons and kinsmen and friends, the king then became filled with anxiety and grief.

sa: तमब्रवीन्महाराज वासुदेवो जनाधिपम्। आर्तायनिमहं जाने यथातत्त्वेन भारत॥
en: Then Vasudeva, O monarch, said to that king-"I know Artayani, O Bharata, as truly illustrious, powerful and energetic.

sa: अभ्यस्यमाने शक्त्यस्त्रे स्कन्देनामिततेजसा। उल्काज्वाला महाराज पपात वसुधातले॥
en: While the dart was repeatedly hurled by Skanda of unfathomable energy, meteors, O king, dropped upon the Earth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तो महाराज कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। आदिदेश सुधर्माणं धौम्यं सूतं च संजयम्॥ विदुरं च महाबुद्धिं युयुत्सुं चैव कौरवम्। इन्द्रसेनमुखांश्चैव भृत्यान् सूतांश्च सर्वशः॥ भवन्तः कारयन्त्वेषां प्रेतकार्याण्यशेषतः। यथा चानाथवत् किंचिच्छरीरं न विनश्यति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed, Kunti's son the highly wise Yudhisthira commanded Sudharman (the priest of the Kauravas), Dhaumya, Sanjaya of the Suta order, Vidura of great wisdom, and Yuyutsu of Kuru's race, and all his servants headed by Indrasena, and all the other Sutas that were with him, saying,—'Cause the funeral rites of the killed, numbering by thousands, to be duly performed, so that so body may die for want of men to take care of them!

sa: दुर्योधनस्य कर्णस्य भीष्मसैन्धवयोरपि। गमयिष्यामि पञ्चालान् पदवीमद्य दुर्गमाम्॥
en: I shall to-day made the Panchalas follow Duryodhana and Karna and Bhishma and the King of the Sindhus!

sa: ततः सौम्येन मन्त्रेण द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। उपहारं महामन्युरथात्मानमुपाहरत्॥
en: The brave and angry son of Drona then, with mantras offered up his own soul as the victim.

sa: हिया च परयाऽऽविष्टो भवन्तं नाधिगच्छति॥ पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तं बुद्धिव्याकुलतेन्द्रियम्। एवमुक्त्वा महाराज धृतराष्ट्र यदूत्तमः॥ उवाच परमं वाक्यं गान्धारी शोककर्शिताम्। सौबलेयि निबोध त्वं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु॥ त्वत्समा नास्ति लोकेऽस्मिन्नद्य सीमन्तिनी शुभे।
en: Out of shame he does not appear before you who are burning with grief on account of your children and whose understanding and senses have been bewildered.'—having said these words to Dhritarashtra, that foremost one Yadu's race, O king, addressed the griefstricken Gandhari in these words of great significance-O daughter of Subala, O you of excellent vows, hear what I say. O auspicious dame, there is no lady like you in world.

sa: वृतं भूतगणैोरैः क्रव्यादैश्च समन्ततः। यथा धनं लिप्समानैर्भूत्यैर्नृपतिसत्तमम्॥
en: Around hiin were many terrible creatures and carnivorous animals, like satellites sceking wealth around a king in state.

sa: तमुग्रतपसा युक्तं भावितं सुमहामुनिम्॥ उपयातो नरव्याघ्र लोकपालो यमस्तदा। तमपश्यत् सुतपस पृषि वै गौतमं तदा॥
en: One day, the Regent of the dead. Yama, O foremost of men, went to that great sage of purified soul while he was practising the severest austerities. Yama saw the great ascetic Gotama of rigid penances.

sa: इत्युच्य देवं स तु सव्यसाची नमस्कृत्वा ब्रह्मणे सोऽमितात्मा। तदुत्तमं ब्राह्ममसह्यमस्त्रं प्रादुश्चक्रे मनसा यद् विधेयम्॥
en: Addressing these words of Keshava Savyaschain, of unfathomable soul, bowing to Brahma, then brought forth into action that unbearable and choice weapon called, Brahma which could only be used after great : concentration of the mind.

sa: एते पापकृतस्तात चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्। श्वापाकबलगृध्राणां सधर्माणो नराधिप॥
en: All of them, O son, are sinful, and live on this Earth, acting like Chandalas, ravens and vultures.

sa: योत्स्येऽहं मातुलेनाद्य क्षात्रधर्मेण पार्थिवाः॥ स्वमंशमभिसंधाय विजयायेतराय च।
en: Observing Kshatriya duties I will fight with my maternal uncle, determined to either win victory or be slain.

sa: ग्रस्तचक्रस्तु राधेयः क्रोधाश्रूण्यवर्तयत्। अर्जुनं वीक्ष्यं संरब्धमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing his wheel thus sunk, Karna wept in anger. And seeing Arjuna before him, he, worked up with

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु कौन्तेयो दीर्घप्रज्ञो महामतिः उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठं व्यासं सत्यवतीसुतम्॥
en: Thus accosted by him, the high-souled and wise son of Kunti, said the following to Satyavati's son Vyasa, that foremost of all orators.

sa: तस्यार्थे पृथिवीपाला: कुरुक्षेत्रं समागताः॥ अन्योन्यं घातयिष्यन्ति दृढैः शस्त्रैः प्रहारिणः।
en: For his sake, many kings assemble together on the field of Kuru, They will cause one another to be killed through hard weapons.

sa: अस्मानन्तकरान् घोरान् पाण्डवान् वृष्णिसंहतान्। आक्रोशन्त्यः कृशा दीनाः प्रपतिष्यन्ति भूतले॥
en: Censuring the Pandavas and the Vrishnis as cruel murderers, those ladies, reduced greatly and sunk in grief, will throw themselves on the Earth.

sa: सुरथं च ततो राजन् भारद्वाजो महारथम्॥ अवाकिरच्छरवातैः सर्वक्षत्रस्य पश्यतः।
en: That great car-warrior, the son of Drona then, O king, covered Suratha with showers of arrows before the eyes of all the Kshatriyas.

sa: न परस्य प्रवादेन परेषां दण्डमर्पयेत्। आगमानुगमं कृत्वा बघ्नीयान्मोक्षयीत वा॥
en: One should not be punished for the fault of another. Bestowing sufficient thought upon the code, a person should be convicted or acquitted.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा राजा बलेन महता वृतः॥ प्रययौ सिंहनादेन कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्।
en: Also encircled by a large force Duryodhana proceeded against the foe, uttering leonine shouts and causing the Earth to resound with that noise.

sa: विवृताक्षश्च कौन्तेयो वेपमानश्च मन्युना। चिच्छेद योधान् निशितैः शरैः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: With eyes opened wide and body trembling in anger the son of Kunti killed hostile warriors in hundreds and thousands with sharp arrows.

sa: सुयोधनमसंगृह्य न शक्या भूः ससागरा। केवला भोक्तुमस्माभिरतश्चैतत् कृतं मया॥
en: Without having killed Suyodhana it was impossible for us to rule peacefully whole Earth with seas. And therefore I acted in that way.

sa: ततः प्रवर्तते युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम्। तावकानां परेषां च निघ्नतामितरेतरम्॥
en: Then took place a dreadful encounter between your soldiers and the enemy, the warriors being all engaged in striking and slaughtering one another.

sa: राज्ञस्त्वन्धस्य वृद्धस्य हतपुत्रस्य केशव॥ त्वं गतिः सहितैर्वीरैः पाण्डवैर्द्विपदां वर।
en: Regarding the blind old king, who had now become childless, O foremost of men, you and the sons of Pandu, are his refuge.'

sa: निकृतेस्तस्य पापस्य ते पारं गमनेप्सवः। चारान् सम्प्रेषयामासुः समन्तात् तद्रणाजिरे॥
en: Desirous of putting an end to that sinful man's evil policy, they had sent spies in all directions on the field of battle.

sa: सा तं दृष्ट्वोग्रतपसं वसिष्ठं तपतां वरम्। आचारैर्मुनिभिर्दृष्टैः पूजयामास भारत।॥
en: Seeing that best of ascetics, viz., Vashishtha, of the austerest penances, she adored him, O Bharata, according to the rites observed by ascetics.

sa: हन्ता कालस्तथा वायुर्मुत्युर्वैश्रवणो रविः। वसवो मरुतः साध्या विश्वेदेवाश्च भारत॥
en: Kala and Mrityu and Vayu and Kubera and Surya, the Vasus, the Maruts, the Saddhyas and the Vishvedevas, O Bharata, are all destroyers.

sa: तमुद्यतगदं वीरं मेनिरे तत्र पाण्डवाः। वैवस्वतमिव क्रुद्धं शूलपाणिमिव स्थितम्॥
en: As he stood with his mace, the Pandavas took him for the angry son of Surya himself armed with his bludgeon called Kinkara.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। तापसैः सह संवादं शक्रस्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: Arjuna said The old history of the discourse between certain ascetics and Shakra, is cited in this connection, O foremost of Bharata's race!

sa: यदस्य रुधिरं गात्रादाहये सम्प्रवर्तते। सह तेनैव रक्तेन सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: The blood that flows from his body purges him off of all his sins along with the very pain that he feels then.

sa: तमुवाच समागत्य भर्तारमकुतोभयम्। क्रुद्धा मनस्विनी भार्या विविक्ते हेतुमद् वचः॥
en: Approaching her husband when he was alone, the queen possessing great strength of mind, fearlessly and in anger, told him these reasonable words:-

sa: प्रमुखे सहदेवस्य जघानाश्वान् स मद्रराट्॥ ततः शल्यस्य तनयं सहदेवोऽसिनावधीत्।
en: The king of the Madras then killed the horses of Sahadeva before his eyes and then Sahadeva killed Shalya's son with his sword.

sa: सोऽथ गत्वाऽऽश्रमं पुण्यं विप्रमुक्तो महातपाः। कथयामास तत् सर्वमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्॥
en: Thus freed, after returning to his sacred hermitage the great ascetic, spoke of what had taken place to those Rishis of pure souls.

sa: हत्वा तत्पुरुषानीकं भीमः सत्यपराक्रमः। धृष्टद्युम्नं पुरस्कृत्य तस्थौ तत्र महाबलः॥
en: Having killed that heroic army Bhima, of great strength, whom it was difficult to defeat in battle, stood there with Dhristadyumna before him.

sa: यतेन्द्रियो नरो राजन् क्रोधलोभनिराकृतः। संतुष्टः सत्यवादी यः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति॥
en: The Man, O king, who has controlled his senses and subdued anger and covetousness, who is contented, and truthful in speech, obtains peace.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनं दृष्ट्वा रथीनीके व्यवस्थितम्। स रथांस्तावकान् सर्वान् हर्षयशकुनिस्ततः॥ दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यं हृष्टरूपो विशाम्पते। कृतकार्यमिवात्मानं मन्यमानोऽब्रवीनृपम्॥ जहि राजन् रथानीकमश्वाः सर्वे जिता मया। नात्यक्त्वा जीवितं संख्ये शक्यो जेतुं युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Beholding Duryodhana stationed in the midst of the car-force, Shakuni, checring up your car-warriors, O king, said these words to Duryodhana, in a manner which showed that he considered all his purposes to have been already accomplished. "Slay, O king, the carwarriors of the Pandavas. All their horse have been defeated by me. Yudhishthira is incapable of being defeated in battle unless one is prepared to sacrifice his life.

sa: सराजकानि राष्ट्राणि नाभागो दक्षिणां ददौ। अन्यत्र श्रोत्रियस्वाच्च तापसार्थाच्च भारत॥
en: King Nabhaga gave away whole kingdoms with their rulers as sacrificial presents to the Brahmanas, save the wealth of learned Brahmanas and ascetics.

sa: हतेषु पार्थिवेन्द्रेषु पुत्रेषु निहतेषु च। पाण्डुपुत्रेषु वै शर्म प्रीतिश्चाप्यवतिष्ठते॥
en: When all the kings have been killed when by children are no more, my well-being and happiness depend upon the sons of Pandu.

sa: शालावृका इति ख्यातास्त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत। अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ते चापि विबुधैर्हताः॥
en: They were known by the name of Shalavrika and were eighty-eight thousand in number. All of them, however, were killed by the gods.

sa: यदत्र हितस्माकं लोकानां चैव सर्वथा। भवन्तौ देवसंकाशौ तथा सम्मन्तुमर्हतः॥ इत्युक्त्वा संजहारास्त्रं पुनरेवं धनंजयः। संहारो दुष्करस्तस्य देवैरपि हि संयुगे॥
en: You two are like gods. You should find out some means by which our well-being, as also that of the three worlds may be secured.'-Saying so Dhananjaya withdrew his weapon. The withdrawal of that weapon can with difficulty be made by the gods themselves in battle.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स श्वाप्रकृतिमापन्नः परं दैन्यमुपागतः। ऋषिणा हुकृतः पापस्तपोवनबहिष्कृतः॥
en: Having once more assumed his proper form, the dog became very dispirited. Chiding him the Rishi drove the sinful creature from his asylum.

sa: पदातिनोऽपि संत्यज्य प्रियं जीवितमात्मनः। भीमाभ्यद्रवन संख्ये पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा॥
en: Then worked up with anger and heedless of their lives the Kuru soldiers rushed upon Bhima like insects falling upon a burning fire.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सलिलान्तर्गतो वसन्। शुश्रुवे तुमुलं शब्दं जलदोपमनिःस्वनम्॥
en: Living within the waters of that lake, king Duryodhana heard the tumult of the Pandava army which reseinbled the muttering of the clouds.

sa: भीष्मो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च महात्माः गौतमः कृपः। ये च तेषां पदानुगाः॥ त्वबुद्ध्या निहते कर्णे हता गोविन्द सर्वथा।
en: O Govinda! I accept the fact that Bhishma, Drona, Karna, Kripacharya, the descendant of Gautama clan and all existing as also erstwhile existed, number of gallants have automatically slaughtered with application of the wit to which you applied for beheading Karma.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम तव पुत्रस्य विक्रमम्। यदेकं सहिताः पार्था नाभ्यवर्तन्त भारत।॥
en: The prowess displayed by your son was highly wonderful, since the Parthas, even in a body, could not approach him who was single.

sa: राजा च धृतराष्ट्रोऽद्य श्रुत्वा पुत्रं निपातितम्॥ स्मरिष्यत्यशुभं कर्म यत्तच्छकुनिबुद्धिजम्।
en: Hearing of the fall of his son to-day, king Dhritarashtra also shall recollect all those evil acts that were the creations of Shakuni!'

sa: ते रथा रथिभिर्युक्ता मनोमारुतरंहसः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे कौन्तेयस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: Those cars, driven by excellent warriors and quick-coursing like the wind or thought, rushed in that battle against the car of Kunti's son.

sa: एतत् ते ब्रह्मदत्तस्य पूजन्या सह भाषितम्। मयोक्तं नृपतिश्रेष्ठ किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: I have thus recited to you, O foremost of kings, the conversation between Brahmadatta and Pujani. What else do you wish to hear.'

sa: सभामध्ये तु कृष्णेन यच्छ्रेयोऽभिहितं मम। अलं वैरेण ते राजन् पुत्रः संगृह्यतामिति॥ तच वाक्यमकृत्वाहं भृशं तप्यामि दुर्मतिः।
en: In the midst of the assembly, Krishna told me what was for my good, saying,-Do away with hostilities, O king! Let your son take the entire kingdom. I did not foolishly follow that advice, and I am now obliged to repent.

sa: दक्षेण यजता चापि गङ्गाद्वारे सरस्वती॥ सुरेणुरिति विख्याता प्रस्रुता शीघ्रगामिनी।
en: Daksha at one time celebrated a sacrifice at the source of Ganga. The Sarasvati appeared there under the name of the quick-coursing Surenu.

sa: वृषा यथा भग्नशृङ्गाः शीर्णदन्ता यथा गजाः। मध्याह्ने प्रत्यपायाम निर्जिताऽजातशत्रुणा॥
en: Like bulls deprive of their horns or elephants with tusks broken, your troops, defeated by Yudhishthira having no enemies, fled away at mid-day.

sa: येन संगृह्णता तात रथमाधिरथेर्युधि। जयार्थं पाण्डुपुत्राणां तथा तेजोवधः कृतः॥
en: When he accepted the drivership of Karna's car in battle, he tried to depress Karna for securing victory for the sons of Pandu.

sa: तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धं परिघं प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवः। अर्जुनस्त्वरितो जघ्ने पञ्चभिः सायकोत्तमैः॥
en: Seeing that mace come towards him like the Destroyer himself in anger Pandu's son Arjuna quickly cut it off with five excellent arrows.

sa: कृतस्य करणाद् राजा स्वर्गमत्यन्तमश्नुते। त्रेतायाः करणाद् राजा स्वर्गं नात्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: If he creates the Krita age, he acquires eternal heaven. If he creates the Treta age, he acquires heaven for a limited period.

sa: दैवं च दैवसंयुक्तं प्राणश्च प्राणदश्च ह। अपेक्षापूर्वकरणादशुभानां शुभं फलम्॥
en: Even evil acts, when performed for divine purposes, the scriptures, life itself, and the means by which life is sustained, yield good consequences.

sa: स्वकाः पितृष्वसुः पुत्रास्ते परैनिकृता भृशम्। प्रतिज्ञापालनं धर्मः क्षत्रियस्येह वेम्यहम्॥
en: The Pandavas are our natural friends. They are the children of our own father's sister! They had been greatly assailed by their enemies.

sa: दुर्गाणां चाभितो राजा मूलच्छेदं प्रकारयेत्। सर्वेषां क्षुद्रवृक्षाणां चैत्यवृक्षान् विवर्जयेत्॥
en: He should demolish all the minor forts in his kingdom. He should also cut down all the smaller trees except those called Chaitya.

sa: ततो धनुातलबाणनिःस्वनैः प्रसह्य कृत्वा च रिपून हतप्रभान्। संछादयित्वा तु कुरूशरोत्तमैः कपिध्वजः पक्षिवरध्वजश्च॥ हृष्टौ ततस्तावमितप्रभावी मनांस्यरीणामवदारयन्तौ। सुवर्णजालावततौ महास्वनौ हिमावदातौ परिगृह्य पाणिभिः। चुचुम्बतुः शङ्खवरौ नृणां वरौ वराननाभ्यां युगपच दध्मतुः॥
en: Divesting perforce the enemy of his splendour by the twang of the Gandiva bow and the striking of palms and destroying the Kurus with arrows the ape-bannered Arjuna and Garuda-bannered Krishna, gifted with measureless prowess, those two best of men joyfully took up, with their hands, their snow white conchs sending forth loud peals, adorned with gold and blew them simultaneously striking terror unto the hearts of their enemies.

sa: ताभिः परिवृतो राजा रुदतीभिः सहस्रशः। निर्ययौ नगराद् दीनस्तूर्णमायोधनं प्रति॥
en: Surrounded by those thousands of wailing ladies, the king issued out of the city in great depression and proceeded quickly towards the battle-field.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अव्याहरति राजेन्द्रे धर्मपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे। गुडाकेशो हृषीकेशमभ्यभाषत पाण्डवः॥
en: "That highest of kings, viz., Yudhishthira the son of Dharma, still rentained silent and Pandu's son Arjuna addressed Krishna and spoke as follows.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं तात परमं स्वयँ का ततः प्रीतिरुत्तमा। किं ततः परमैश्वर्यं ब्रूहि मे यदि पश्यसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said What acts, O sir, lead to heaven? What is the nature of the great happiness that is derived from them? What also is the high prosperity that may be obtained from them? Tell me all this, if you know.

sa: दुर्योधनबलान्मुक्ता वयमेव त्रयो रथाः। सर्वमन्यत् परिक्षीणं सैन्यं ते भरतर्षभ॥
en: We are the only three car-warriors of Duryodhana's army that are yet alive. All the others, O foremost of Bharata's race, have died.'

sa: ये हि धर्माः समाख्याताश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य भारत॥ चातुराश्रभ्यसंयुक्ताः सर्वे ते विदितास्तव।
en: All the duties that have been laid down for the four orders about the four modes of life and well known to you.

sa: नक्तमेव च भक्तानि पाचयेत नराधिपः। न दिवा ज्वालयेदग्निं वर्जयित्वाऽऽग्निहोत्रिकम्॥
en: He should order all food to be cooked at night. No fire should be lighted during the day, except for the daily Homa.

sa: बभूव श्रीमती राजशाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः। सुता धृतव्रता साध्वी नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी॥
en: The great Shandilya, O king, had a beautiful daughter who was chaste, observant of severe vows self-restrained, and led a life of cclibacy.

sa: आदानादपि भूतानां मधुरामीरयन् गिरम्। सर्वलोकमिमं शक्र सान्त्वेन कुरुते वशे॥
en: If even the wealth of men, O Shakra, be snatched away with sweet speeches, such sweetness of conduct can even propitiate the robbed.

sa: हतबान्धवभूयिष्ठा हताश्वा हतकुञ्जरा। एषा ते पृथिवी राजन् भुवनां विगतज्वरः॥
en: Deprived entirely of friends and allies, of horses and elephants, this Earth exists for you, O king. Do you enjoy her now cheerfully.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच । सान्त्वमेकपदं शक्र पुरुषः सम्यगाचरन्। प्रमाणं सर्वभूतानां यशश्चैवाप्नुयान्महत्॥
en: Brihaspati said Sweetness of speech. O Shakra, is the one thing by practising which a person is esteemed by all and becomes famous.

sa: अजाश्च पृश्नयश्चैव सिकताश्चैव भारत। अरुणाः केतवश्चैव स्वाध्यायेन दिवं गताः॥
en: The Ajas, the Prishnis, the Sikatas, O Bharata, Arunas, and the Ketavas, have all gone to heaven by the merit of Vedic study.

sa: ततो हतं परैस्तत्र मद्रराजबलं तदा। दुर्योधनबलं दृष्ट्वा पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्॥
en: The army of the Madrakas then were killed by the foc. Beholding this, the troops of Duryodhana once more fled from the battle.

sa: विष्वग्वाताः प्रादुरासन् नीचैः शर्करवर्षिणः॥ अश्रूणि मुमुचुर्नागा वेपथु चास्पृशन् भृशम्।
en: There blew a hurricane on all sides, carrying away hard pebbles along its lower course. The elephants shed profuse tears and trembled greatly.

sa: एष शेते महाबाहुर्बलवान् सत्यविक्रमः। तमद्य द्विपः संख्ये भीमसेनेन पातितः॥
en: Endued with great strength and true prowess, this mighty-armed prince, killed by Bhimasena in battle, sleeps like in elephant killed by a lion.

sa: धनूंषि समिधस्तत्र पवित्राणि शिताः शराः। हविरात्मवतश्चात्मा तस्मिन् भारत कर्मणि॥
en: Bows were the fuel, and sliarp arrows were the ladles, and his own great soul was the libation, in that act of sacrifice.

sa: विदित्वा परमास्त्राणि क्षत्रधर्मव्रते स्थितः॥ षष्टिं वर्षाणि धर्मात्मा वसुधां पालयिष्यति।
en: Having acquired all knowledge of all high weapons and observing all Kshatriya duties, that righteous king shall rule the earth for sixty years.

sa: भाण्डागारायुधागारान् योधागारांश्च सर्वशः। अश्वागारान् गजागारान् बलाधिकरणानि च॥ परिखाश्चैव कौरव्य प्रतोलीनिष्कुटानि च। न जात्वन्यः प्रपश्येत मुह्यमेतद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Shops of necessary articles, arsenals, camps and quarters for soldiers, stables for horses and elephants, encampments, of soldiers, trenches, streets and lanes, houses and pleasure gardens should be so made that their situations may not be known to others, O Yudhishthira.

sa: अल्पेनाल्पेन देयेन वर्धमानं प्रदापयेत्। ततो भूयस्ततो भूयः क्रमवृद्धिं समाचरेत्॥
en: Little by little should be drained from a prosperous subject. The demand should then be gradually increased till it reaches a fair amount.

sa: ततस्तु सौबलो राजन्नभ्यतिक्रम्य पाण्डवान्। जघान पृष्ठतः सेनां जयगृद्धः प्रतापवान्॥
en: However, O king, overpowering the Pandavas and longing for victory, Subala's son, of great valour, began to slay their forces from the back.

sa: अहमुत्थाय सर्वान् वै प्रतियोत्स्यामि संयुगे। अनुगम्यागतान् सर्वानृतून् संवत्सरो यथा॥
en: The fame, O king, of all righteous men depends on righteousness. I say all this to you who are both righteous and illustrious.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं द्वादशवार्पिक्यामनावृष्ट्यां द्विजोत्तमान्। ऋषीनध्यापयामास पुरा सारस्वतो मुनिः॥
en: Janamejaya said "Why did the sage Sarasvat, O you of ascetic merit, teach the Vedas to the Rishis during a twelve years' drought?

sa: एवं यो धर्मविद् राजा ब्रह्मपूर्वं प्रवर्तते। जयत्यविजितामुर्वी यशश्च महदश्नुते॥
en: That virtuous king, who governs his kingdom, aided by and revering the Brahmana, succeeds in subjugating the whole Earth and acquiring great fame.

sa: ते हि शूरा महेष्वासाः क्षिप्रमेष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः। अमर्षवशमापन्ना वैरं प्रतिजिहीर्षवः॥
en: Our enemies, the Pandavas, are all heroes and great bowmen. They will soon attack us, filled with rage, for taking vengeance on us.

sa: पाण्डवाश्चापि गोविन्दं पुरस्कृत्य हतद्विषः। कृष्णद्वैपायनं चैव नारदं च महामुनिम्॥ द्रोणपुत्रस्य सहजं मणिमादाय सत्वराः। द्रौपदीमभ्यधावन्त प्रायोपेतां मनस्विनीम्॥
en: The Pandavas, who had killed all their foes, put Govinda and the Krishna-Dvaipayana and the great ascetic Narada at their head, and taking the gem that born with Ashvatthaman, quickly returned to the intelligent Draupadi who was observing the Praya vow."

sa: यत्र तप्तं तपो घोरमार्टिषेणेन भारत। ब्राह्मण्यं लब्धवांस्तत्र विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः॥
en: There, O Bharata, Arshtishena had in days of yore practised austerest of penances. There the great (Kshatriya) Muni Muni Vishvamitra became a Brahmana.

sa: मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञो राम त्वं कत्थसे जनसंसदि॥ भयात् क्षत्रियवीराणां पर्वतं समुपाश्रितः।
en: You are not truthful, O Rama! You simply brag before people. For fear of Kshatriya heroes you have betaken yourself to the mountains.

sa: शरसंकृत्तवर्माणं वीरं विशसने हतम्। परिवार्यासते गृध्राः पश्य कृष्ण विविंशतिम्॥
en: His armour has been cut with arrows. Killed in the general destruction, the heroic Vivingshati is now encircled and waited upon by vultures.

sa: बुभौ व्यभाता समरेऽच्युतार्जुनौ। तमो निहत्याभ्युदितौ यथामलौ शशाङ्कसूर्यो दिवि रश्मिमालिनौ॥
en: Pierced with Karna's arrows those two repressors of foes shone like the bright moon of many rays and the sun after dispelling darkness.

sa: जगाम हास्तिनपुरं कृपः शारद्वतस्तदा। स्वमेव राष्ट्रं हार्दिक्यो द्रौणिर्व्यासाश्रमं ययौ॥
en: Sharadvat's Kripa went to Hastinapura; Hridika's son went to his own kingdom; while the son of Drona started for the hermitage of Vyasa.

sa: यथा यथैव जीवेद्धि तत् कर्तव्यमहेलया। जीवितं मरणाच्छ्यो जीवन् धर्ममवाप्नुयात्॥
en: That by which life may be preserved should, forsooth, be done unhesitatingly. Life is better than death. By living, one may acquire virtue.

sa: गाण्डीवं ज्यां च बाणंश्च सोऽनुमन्त्र्य परंतपः। व्यसृजच्छरवर्षाणि वर्षाणीव पुरन्दरः॥
en: Then inspiring his Gandiva, its strings and arrows with mantras that repressor of enemies discharged arrows like Indra pouring down torrents of rain.

sa: भवितव्यं सदा राज्ञा गर्भिणीसहधर्मिणा। कारणं च महाराज शृणु येनेदमिष्यते॥
en: The king should always treat his subjects as a mother does the child of her womb. Hear, O king, why this is desirable.

sa: शून्यमायोधनं कृत्वा शरवर्षेः समन्ततः। अभ्यद्रवत मद्रेशं तिष्ठ शल्येति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having made the field empty by discharging his arrows on all sides, Yudhishthira proceeded against the king of the Madras and said-Wait, Wait.

sa: यस्मात् सर्वाः प्रसूयन्ते सर्गप्रलयविक्रियाः। यस्मिंश्चैव प्रलीयन्ते तस्मै हेत्वात्मने नमः॥
en: Birth and death originate from you. All things, again, at the universal dissolution, are dissolved in you. Salutations to your form as cause.

sa: तं तथा भस्मभूतं तु दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुसुताः प्रभो। अभवन् विस्मिता राजन्नर्जुनश्चेदमब्रवीत्॥ कृताञ्जलिः सप्रणयं प्रणिपत्याभिवाद्य ह। गोविन्द कस्माद् भगवन् रथोदग्धोऽयमग्निना॥
en: Seeing the vehicle thus reduced to ashes, O Iord, the sons of Pandu filled with wonder, and Arjuna, O king, having saluted Krishna and bowed un.o him, said these words, with joined hands, 'O Govinda, O divine one, why has this car been consumed by fire?

sa: तमिमं पृथिवी सर्वा एकाह्ना समपद्यता धर्मात्मानं महात्मानं शूरमिन्द्रसमं युधि॥
en: The whole Earth in one day was subjugated by that high-souled and virtuous and brave king who was like Indra himself in prowess.

sa: असिर्विशसनो धर्मस्तीक्ष्णवर्मा दुराधरः। श्रीगर्भो विजयः शास्ता व्यवहारः सनातनः॥ शास्त्रं ब्राह्मणमन्त्राश्च शास्ता प्राग्वदतां वरः। धर्मपालोऽक्षरो देवः सत्यगो नित्यगोऽग्रजः॥ असंगो रुद्रतनयो मनुर्येष्ठः शिवंकरः। नामान्येतानि दण्डस्य कीर्तितानि युधिष्ठिर॥
en: These, O Yudhishthira, are some of the names of Punishment viz., sword, Sabre, Righteousness, Fury, the Irresistible, the father of prosperity, Victory, Punisher, Checker, the Eternal, the Scriptures, Brahmana, Mantra, Avenger, the Foremost of first Legislators, Judge, the Undecaying, god, the individual of irresistible course, the Ever-going, the Firstborn, the individual without love the Soul of Rudra, the eldest Manu, and the great Benefiter.

sa: दिष्ट्या च वोऽहं पश्यामि मुक्तानस्माजनक्षयात्। स्वस्तियुक्तांश्च कल्यांश्च तन्मे प्रियमनुत्तमम्॥
en: By good luck, I see you escaped alive from this great destruction, and are safe and sound! This is highly pleasing to me!

sa: अद्य सप्तदशाहानि वर्तमानस्य भारत। संग्रामस्यातिघोरस्य वध्यतां चाभितो युधि॥ ते
en: Today is the seventeenth day of this dreadful battle, O Bharata, of those that are being killed in the midst of this fight.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणुष्वावहितो राजशुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः। भीष्मस्य कुरुशार्दूल देहोत्सर्ग महात्मनः॥
en: Listen, O king, with pure heart and rapt attention, as to how, O foremost of the Kurus, the great Bhishma renounced his body.

sa: तस्मान्मानयितव्यास्ते गणमुख्याः प्रधानतः । लोकयात्रा समायत्ता भूयसी तेषु पार्थिव॥
en: Therefore, the leaders of the aristocracy should be honoured by the king. The affairs of the kingdom, o king, depend greatly upon them.

sa: ततो वासं परीक्षेत धर्मनित्येषु साधुषु। मनुष्येषु वदान्येषु स्वधर्मनिरतेषु च।॥
en: One should seek to live among honest men given to righteousness and liberality and the observance of the duties of their own order,

sa: चित्तस्य हि प्रसादेन हित्वा कर्म शुभाशुभम्। प्रसन्नात्माऽऽत्मनि स्थित्वा सुखमानन्त्यमश्नुते॥ मानसोऽग्निः शरीरेषु जीव इत्यभिधीयते। सृष्टिः प्रजापतेरेषा भूताध्यात्मविनिश्चये॥
en: The king, effulgent, like fire living within the mind is called the living agent. It is from that Lord of everything that this creation has originated. This is the conclusion of the enquiry into the origin of creatures and the soul.

sa: गुणवन्तमपत्यं सा अचिराज्जनयिष्यति। मम प्रसादात् कल्याणि माऽभूत् ते प्रणयोऽन्यथा॥२५
en: By my favour, O blessed one, she will soon give birth to a son gifted with every virtue! May your request be fulfilled!

sa: यदा प्रार्थयते किंचित् तदा भवति सा मनः। अधिष्ठानानि वै बुद्ध्यां पृथगेतानि संस्मरेत्। इन्द्रियाण्येव मेध्यानि विजेतव्यानि कृत्स्नशः॥
en: When the Understanding desires anything, it is called by the name of Mind. The senses, again, should all be considered as contained within the Understanding. The senses, which are engaged in bearing impressions of form, scent, etc., should all be controlled.

sa: नैव स्त्री न पुमानेतन्नैव चेदं नपुंसकम्। अदुःखमसुखं ब्रह्म भूतभव्यभवात्मकम्॥
en: Brahma has no sex,-inale, a female, or neuter. It is neither sorrow nor happiness. Its essence the past, the future, and the present.

sa: यदि प्रमाणं धर्मस्ते गृहस्थाश्रमसम्मतः। प्रदानेनात्मनो राज्ञि कर्तुमर्हसि मे प्रियम्॥
en: If the duties prescribed for householders be acceptable to you, do you, O princess, satisfy me by offering up your body to me.

sa: तां कम्पयित्वा भगवान् प्रह्लादमिदमब्रवीत्॥ पश्य वीर्यं कुमारस्य नैतदन्यः करिष्यति।
en: Having shaken it himself, the divine Vishnu, addressing Prahlada, said,-see the might of Kumara! None else in the universe can raise this dart.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव यदा पिण्डीकरोत्ययम्। एष ध्यानपथः पूर्वो मया समनुवर्णितः॥
en: I have spoken of the path of meditation as the first, since the Yogin has first to destroy his senses and the mind.

sa: ततोऽस्याः स्वागतं कृत्वा व्यादिश्य च वरासनम्। पूजितां पादशौचेन वरान्नेनाप्यतर्पयत्॥
en: Welcoming her, he assigned her an excellent seat, honoured her by offering water to wash her feet, and pleased her with excellent refreshments.

sa: इमां ज्वरोत्पत्तिमदीनमानसः पठेत् सदा यः सुसमाहितो नरः। विमुक्तरोगः स सुखी मुदा युतो लभेत कामान् स यथामनीषितान्॥
en: That man who will read this account of the origin of Fever with rapt attention and cheerful heart shall become free from disease and shall always have happiness for his lot. Filled with joy he shall have all his wishes gratified.

sa: तत्रादह्यन्त भूतानि जङ्गमानि ध्रुवाणि च। महता क्रोधवेगेन कुपिते प्रपितामहे॥
en: Truly, when the Grandfather thus became angry, all mobile and immobile beings began to be consumed by the irresistible power of that anger.

sa: ततो विष्णुर्महातेजा वाराहं रूपमास्थितः। अन्तर्भूमि सम्प्रविश्य जगाम दितिजान् प्रति॥
en: Sometime after, Vishnu of mighty energy, assuming the form of a Boar, penetrating into the neither regions, rushed against those children of Diti.

sa: नारद उवाच अद्य मे तपसो देव यमस्य नियमस्य च। सद्यः फलमवाप्तं वै दृष्टो यद् भगवान् मया॥
en: Narada said Since, O holy one, I have to-day succeeded in seeing you, I think that I have acquired forthwith the fruits of my penances, O God, of my self-restraint, and of all the vows and observances that I have practised.

sa: असंख्येयानि चास्त्राणि तस्य दिव्यानि धीमतः। प्राधान्यतो मयैतानि कीर्तितानि तवानघ॥
en: I saw with the highly intelligent Mahadeva numberless other celestial weapons. I have, however, named only a few principal ones, O sinless one.

sa: ततः सत्यवती हृष्टा मातरं प्रत्यभाषत। यदृचीकेन कथितं तच्चाचख्यौ चरुद्वयम्॥
en: Thereat, Satyavati, pleased at heart, told her mother all that had been said by Richika as also of the two balls of charu.

sa: व्यत्यासं वृक्षयोश्चापि करवाव शुचिस्मिते। यदि प्रमाणं वचनं मम मातुरनिन्दिते॥
en: O sweetlysmiling one of pure character, if you have any reverence for my word, let us change the trees respectively intended for us.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् पुनर्मृत्युर्भगवन्तं पितामहम्। न हरेयं प्रजा देव पुनश्चाहं प्रसादये॥
en: Addressing the divine Grandfather, the maiden once more said, I am unable to destroy living creatures, O god! I seek to please you.

sa: तस्य प्रभावयुक्तस्य निमित्तं देहभेदने। यथैवोत्पद्यते किंचित् पञ्चत्वं गच्छते तथा॥ पुण्यपापविनाशान्ते पुण्यपापसमीरितः। देहं विशति कालेन ततोऽयं कर्मसम्भवम्॥
en: Whatever creature is born is resolved once more into the five principal elements upon the exhaustion of his merits and demerits; and moved again by the merits and demerits acquired in that life enters into another body resulting from his deeds.

sa: परिच्छिद्यैव कामानां सर्वेषां चैव कर्मणाम्। मूलं बुद्धीन्द्रियग्रामं शकुन्तानिव पञ्जरे॥
en: One should shut up, like birds in a cage, the very springs, viz., the understanding and the senses, of his desires and acts.

sa: तमासीनं महाप्रज्ञमुशना वाक्यमब्रवीत्। ब्रूह्यस्मै दानवेन्द्राय विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्॥ एष चाक्षिपते काले
en: After the highly wise Kumara had been seated, Ushanas said to him,-Describe to this king of the Danavas the pre-eminent greatness of Vishnu.

sa: मुनिरुवाच धर्मनिश्चयसंयुक्तां कामार्थसहितां कथाम्। शृणुष्वावहितो राजन् गदतो मे महाभुज॥
en: The sage said O mighty-armed king, listen to me as I describe to you this story containing lessons of Virtue, profit, and Desire.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच यत्र वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च तपः सत्यं दमस्तथा॥ अहिंसाधर्मसंयुक्ताः प्रचरेयुः सुरोत्तमाः। स वो देशः सेवितव्यो मा वोऽधर्मः पदा स्पृशेत्।।८९
en: You foremost of gods, ye should, in that age, go to such places where the Vedas and Sacrifices and Penances and Truth and selfcontrol, accompanied by duties fraught with mercy for all creatures, will still continue. Sin will never be able to affect you at all.

sa: गता त्रिरष्टवर्षता ध्रुवोऽसि पञ्चविंशकः। कुरुष्व धर्मसंचय वयो हि तेऽतिवर्तते॥
en: You have passed twenty-four years. You are now full twenty-five years of age. Your years are passing away. Begin now to husband virtue.

sa: आहारनियमं चैव देशे काले च सात्त्विकम्। तत् परीक्ष्यानुवर्तेत तत्प्रवृत्त्यनुपूर्वकम्॥
en: Reflecting upon the characteristics of time and place, one should according to his inclinations observe, after proper search, vows and rules about fasts.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वैतदाख्यानवरं धर्मराड् जनमेजय॥ भ्रातरश्चास्य ते सर्वे नारायणपराऽभवन्।
en: Vaishampayana said Having listened to this best of discourses, O Janamejaya, king Yudhisthira the just, and all his brothers became devoted to Narayana.

sa: अग्रयः प्रहरणानां च खड्गो माद्रवतीसुत। महेश्वरप्रणीतश्च पुराणे निश्चयं गतः॥
en: Of all weapons, O son of Madravati, the sword is the greatest. The Puranas truly say that it was first held by Mahadeva.

sa: आदादेव हि तच्छास्त्रमोंकारस्वरपूजितम्। ऋषिभिः श्रावितं यत्र तत्र कारुणिको ह्यसौ॥
en: Having composed that work sanctified with the syllable OM, the Rishis first of all read it to Narayana, who heard them from kindness.

sa: ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थमपृच्छद् ब्राह्मणान् बहून्। पर्यटन् पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना देशे देशे नराधिपः॥
en: For purifying himself of the sin of Brahmanicide he asked many Brahmanas, and travelled from one country to another over the whole Earth.

sa: इमानीष्टविभागानि फलानि तपसः सदा। तपसा शक्यते प्राप्तुं देवत्वमपि निश्चयात्॥
en: The luminous bodies in the sky have got their position through penance. Forsooth, through penance the very status of godhead may be gained.

sa: गुप्तानि चत्वारि यथागमं मे शत्रौ च मित्रे च समोऽस्मि नित्यम्। तं चादिदेवं सततं प्रपन्न एकान्तभावेन वृणोम्यजस्रम्॥
en: As laid down in the scriptures, I have always protected the four that should be protected. I always treat impartially friends and enemies. Wholly and surely given to Him, that first of gods, viz., the Supreme Soul, I incessantly worship Him.

sa: सामवेदश्च वेदानां यजुषां शतरुद्रियम्। सनत्कुमारो योगानां सांख्यानां कपिलो ह्यसि।।३२३।
en: Among the Vedas you arc thc Samans, among the Yajushes you the Shatarudriyam, among Yogins you Sanatkumara, and among Sankhyas you are Kapila.

sa: मणिभद्रं स तत्रस्थं देवतानां महाद्युतिम्। अपश्यत महात्मानं व्यादिशन्तं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Indeed, O Yudhishthira, he saw the great and highly effulgent Manibhadra stationed in the midst of the gods, engaged in giving his orders.

sa: सर्वथा क्षमिणा भाव्यं तथा सत्यपरेण च। वीतहर्षभयक्रोधो धृतिमाप्नोति पण्डितः॥
en: One should always practise forgiveness and be devoted to truth. The wise man who can renounce joy, fear and anger, can gain fortitude.

sa: श्रूयते च कपोतेन शत्रुः शरणमागतः। पूजितश्च यथान्यायं स्वैश्च मांसैर्निमन्त्रितः॥
en: We have heard that a pigeon received reverentially a suppliant enemy according to due rites and even fed him with his own flesh.'

sa: ततो मां भगवानाह साम्ना परमवल्गुना। लप्स्यसे तनयं कृष्ण आत्मतुल्यमसंशयम्॥
en: The illustrious Upamanyu then addressed me in words which were highly sweet and delightfulYou shall, O Krishna, obtain, forsooth, a son like yourself.

sa: ते तेन समनुज्ञाता ब्राह्मणेन भुजङ्गमाः। स्वमेव भवनं जग्मुरकृतार्था नरर्षभ॥
en: The assembled Nagas, thus addressed by Brahmana, were sent away by him, whereupon, O forcmost of men, they returned to their respective quarters.

sa: शतानि सप्त चैवाहं वायुभक्षस्तदाभवम्। एक वर्षसहस्रं तु दिव्यमाराधितो मया॥
en: After that I passed seven hundred ycars, living on air only. In this way I worshipped Mahadeva for a full thousand divine years.

sa: परिभ्रमति भूतात्मा द्यामिवाम्बुधरो महान्॥ स पुनर्जायते राजन् प्राप्येहायतनं नृप।
en: ones It roves through the sky for sometime take a spacious cloud. Getting a new receptacle, O king, it then takes birth again.

sa: ज्योतिषोऽपि गुणं रूपं वायुराददते यदा। प्रशाम्यति ततो ज्योतिर्वायुर्दोधूयते महान्॥
en: Then Wind comes and takes the attribute, viz., form, of Heat of Light, which, possessed of great power, begins to be awfully agitated.

sa: स्थापितो ह्यस्य समयः पूर्वमेव स्वयम्भुवा। अजस्रं परियात्येष सत्येनावतपन् प्रजाः॥
en: The self-create has before this ordinated the laws which regulate the Sun's motions. Giving light and heat to all creatures, he shines continually.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण महामते। न हि मे तृप्तिरस्तीह शृण्वतोऽमृतमुत्तमम्॥
en: I wish to hear all this in full, you of great intelligence. I am never satiated with hearing your excellent and nectar-like words.

sa: सावर्णिश्चापि विख्यात ऋषिरासीत् कृते युगे। इह तेन तपस्तप्तं षष्टिवर्षशतान्यथ॥
en: There was a celebrated Rishi named Savarni in the golden age. Here in this hermitage, he practised sevcrc pchances for six thousand years.

sa: विस्तराः क्लेशसंयुक्ताः संक्षेपास्तु सुखावहाः। परार्थं विस्तराः सर्वे त्यागमात्महितं विदुः॥
en: The Many yield misery; while the Few yield happiness. The Many are the fruits represented by the Nescience. Renunciation produces the soul's benefit.

sa: अष्टवक्र उवाच स्वतन्त्रा त्वं कथं भद्रे बूहि कारणमत्र वै। नास्ति त्रिलोके स्त्री काचिद् या वै स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति॥
en: Ashtavakra said How is it, O good lady that you are your own mistress? Tell me the reason of this. There is not a single woman in the three worlds who can be considered as the mistress of her own self.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तथा धर्मविरोधेन प्रियमिथ्याभिधायिना। श्मशानवासिना नित्यं रात्रिं मृगयता नृप॥ ततो मध्यस्थतां नीता वचनैरमृतोपमैः। जम्बुकेन स्वकार्यार्थं बान्धवास्तस्य धिष्ठिताः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus, O king, the kinsmen of the dead child, unable to settle what they should do, were, for fulfilling his own purpose, induced by that sinful jackal who uttered sweet falsehoods-that dweller of the crematorium who went there every night in search of food.

sa: इत्येतल्लोकनिर्माणं ब्रह्मणा विहितं पुरा। प्रजाः समनुवर्तन्ते स्वैः स्वैः कर्मभिरावृताः॥
en: In days of yore thus did Brahman ordain that the creation should go on. Each, by his own deeds, obtain happiness and misery.

sa: प्रसार्येह यथाङ्गानि कूर्मः संहरते पुनः। तद्वन्महान्ति भूतानि यवीयःसु विकुर्वते॥
en: Like a tortoise extending out its limbs and withdrawing then again, the great elements, by living in innumerable small forms, go through transformations.

sa: एतद्धयशिरो राजन्नाख्यानं तव कीर्तितम्। पुराणं वेदसमितं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: I have thus recounted to you, O king, the old story of Hayashiras, agreeable to the Vedas, about which you had asked me.

sa: न यान्ति चैव ते सम्यगभिप्रेतमसंशयम्। अन्येऽपश्यंस्तथा सम्यगाश्रमाणां परां गतिम्॥
en: When seen with gross vision, all the Ashramas do not exhibit their true intent! Others, however, having subtle sight, see their highest end.

sa: स विनिन्दंस्तथाऽऽत्मानं पुनः पुनरुवाच ह। अविश्वास्यः सुदुर्बुद्धिः सदा निकृतिनिश्चयः॥
en: Thus censuring himself he began to say again and again,-I do not deserve any credit! My understanding is wicked! I am ever sinful!

sa: ऋषिरेष महातेजा नारायणसहायवान्। पुराणः शाश्वतो देवस्त्वजेयी जिष्णुरच्युतः॥ अस्त्राणीन्द्राच्च रुद्राच्च लोकपालेभ्य एव च। समादाय महाबाहुर्महत् कर्म करिष्यति॥
en: He is a Rishi of great effulgence; he is the friend of Narayana (Krishna); he is ancient, eternal celestials, invincible, ever successful and undeteriorating. O mighty-armed hero, he will achieve great deeds by receiving weapons from Indra, Rudra and the Lokapalas.

sa: अत्रैनं हि महाभागाः सर्वभूतहिते रताः। अतिथिं पर्णशालायां राघवं संन्यवेशयन्॥
en: And those persons of exalted virtue, engaged in the welfare of all creatures, made Rāghava, their guest, sit down in their thatched cottage.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततो भीममन्तर्धानं गतस्तदा। महता शरवर्षेण भृशं तं समवाकिरत्॥
en: Having thus spoken to Bhima, he became invisible then and there; and then he covered the former with a thick shower of arrows.

sa: बाष्पैः पिहितकण्ठश्च प्रेक्ष्य रामं यशस्विनम्। आर्येत्येवाभिसंक्रुश्य व्याहतु नाशकत् ततः॥
en: And beholding the illustrious Rāma, Bharata with his utterance choked with emotion, exclaimed, O noble one, and was unable to say anything further.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु नृपतिस्तक्षकाय चुकोप है। उत्तङ्कवाक्यहविषा दीप्तोऽग्निर्हविषा यथा॥
en: Sauti said : The king, having heard these words, got angry on Takshaka. Uttanka's speech inflamed him as ghee does the sacrificial fire.

sa: पार्थिवानीव चाभान्ति पद्मरागमयानि च। शैलानीव च दृश्यन्ते दारवाणीव चाप्युत॥
en: They shine as if, made of bricks and set with Padmaraga gems, and they look as if made of stones or of wood.

sa: विपत्तिष्वव्यथो दक्षो नित्यमुत्थानवान् नरः। अप्रमत्तो विनीतात्मा नित्यं भद्राणि पश्यति॥
en: He who is unmoved in calamity, is skilled in his own business, is ever exerting, vigilant, and humble will always meet with prosperity.

sa: प्राक्स्रोतसश्च या नद्यस्तिर्यक्स्रोतस एव च। पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च समायान्त्वद्य सर्वशः॥
en: Let those rivers that flow westwards, and those that move tortuously on the earth and in the sky, come hither in a body.

sa: स विद्धो बहुभिर्वाणैर्नीलाञ्जनचयोपमः। शुशुभे सर्वतो राजन् प्रफुल्ल इव किशुकः॥
en: Thus pierced with many shafts that Rakshasa resembling a heap of antimony looked beautiful, O king like a Kinshuka tree decorated with flowers.

sa: पुनश्चतु:शतान् हत्वा भीमं विव्याध पत्रिणा। सोऽतिविद्धस्तथा भीमो राक्षसेन महाबलः॥
en: Once more slaying four hunderd warriors, he pierced Bhima with winged shafts. Then thus deeply peirced by that Rakshasa, the highly puissant Bhima.

sa: आर्ण्यशृङ्गिं ततो भीमो नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः। विव्याध प्रहसन राजन् राक्षसेन्द्रममर्षणम्॥
en: Then, O king, with nine shafts of depressed knots, Bhima smilingly pierced, O king, that wrathful son of Rishyshringa, that foremost of Rakshasas.

sa: आर्जुनिस्तु हयांस्तस्य चतुर्भिनिशितैः शरैः। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: Then the son of Arjuna filled with rage dispatched the four horses of him to the region of Death with four whetted shafts.

sa: ततोऽष्टमे दिवसे प्रत्यबुध्यत पाण्डवः। तस्मिंस्तदा रसे जीर्णे सोऽप्रमेयबलो बली।॥
en: The Pandava (Bhima) awoke from his sleep on the eight days and he left himself strong beyond measure by digesting that Rasa (ambrosia).

sa: तदेतत्सर्वमातिष्ठ वीर्य भीमपराक्रम। नहि ते सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यते सदृशो बली॥
en: Therefore, o you of dreadful strength! summon your entire energy. Him find I not among all beings, who is your peer in prowess.

sa: मया क्रुद्धेन समरे पाण्डवार्थे निपातिताम्। श्वः सदेवाः सगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः॥
en: And overthrown by my enraged self, for the sake of Arjuna. Tomorrow the celestials, the Gandharvas, the Pisachas, the reptiles and the Rakshasas.

sa: जयद्रथं वधिष्यामि श्वोभूत इति दारुक। तत्तु दुर्योधनः श्रुत्वा मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रयिष्यति॥
en: O Daruka, saying Before tomorrow's sun sets, I will slay Jayadratha-having heard of this vow, Duryodhana will surely hold counsel with his counsellors.

sa: ते रथैः सुसम्प्रयुक्तैर्दन्तिभिश्च महारथाः। परिवार्य रणे भीष्मं दंशिताः समवस्थिताः॥
en: The mighty car-warriors of the Kurus, clad in Armour, and supported by those cars and many elephants formed themselves in battlearray encircling Bhishma.

sa: यः समुत्पतितं क्रोधं क्षमयैव निरस्यति। यथोरगस्त्वचं जीर्णा स पुरुष
en: He is the proper person who can subdue his rising ire by means of forgiveness as a serpent leaves off his worn skin.

sa: ततः स शववर्षेण पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्। अभ्यवर्षदमेयात्मा क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः॥
en: Then that best of Kshatriyas, of great cnergy, poured upon all the Kshatriyas showers of arrows even like Indra pouring rain in torrents.

sa: संनिपत्य तु शाखायां न्यग्रोधस्य विहङ्गमः। सुप्ताञ्जधान सुबहून् वायसान् वायसान्तकः॥
en: That sky-ranger, that slayer of crows, alighting on one of the branches of the banian, killed a large number of his sleeping enemies.

sa: तवैव दुष्कृतैर्वीरौ भीष्मद्रोणौ निपातितौ॥ कर्णश्च निहतः संख्ये तव शीलानुवर्तकः।
en: Through your deeds those two heroes, viz., Bhishma and Drona, have been killed. Karna has been slain for having followed your conduct !

sa: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत् पीडया क्रियते तपः। परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत् तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Tama Penance is that which is performed under a deluded belief, and with torture of one's self, and for the destruction of another,

sa: दर्शयन्तोऽन्तिके चकुर्नैशं त्रैयम्बकं बलिम्। ततः प्रीतमनाः पार्थो गन्धमाल्यैश्च माधवम्॥
en: Performed the usual nightly ceremony of offering victims to the three-eyed Mahadeva. Thereafter with a delighted heart, Pritha's son, with perfumes and garlands.

sa: अलंचकार तां शय्यां परिवार्यायुधोत्तमैः। ततः स्पृष्टोदके पार्थे विनीताः परिचारकाः॥
en: He decorated that bed and then kept around it many excellent weapons. Then when Partha also had touched water, obedient and humble servants.

sa: अपुत्रा पुरुषव्याघ्र विललापेति नः श्रुतम्। भद्रा परमदुःखार्ता तन्निबोध जनाधिप॥
en: O best of men, O king, hear how Bhadra, being childless and afflicted with grief, bewailed for her husband. I shall recount it.

sa: अद्य भित्वा मया मुक्ताः शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः। विदार्यातिपतिष्यन्ति वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Today the gold-decked arrows discharged by ine, piercing (your body), shall enter into the carth, cleaving it, like serpents falling into an ant-hill.

sa: व्युषिताश्व इति ख्यातो बभूव किल पार्थिवः। पुरा परमधर्मिष्ठः पूरोर्वंशविवर्धनः॥
en: "In ancient times there was a king known by the name of Vyushitashva, the expander of the Puru dynasty, who was exceedingly virtuous.

sa: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत् त्रिविधं नरैः। अफलार्काक्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते॥
en: Now Sattva Penance is that in which this three-fold penance is performed with perfect faith, with devotion and without the desire for fruit.

sa: ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे सामात्यप्रमुखा जनाः। अद्य स्म निर्वृता राजन् पुरे जनपदेऽपि च। उपासितुं पुन: प्राप्ता देवा इव शतक्रतुम्॥
en: All the officers of government, headed by their minister, addressed him with folded hands, saying, "O king, really we are all glad today both in the city and the country, even as the gods themselves, after having obtained their chief of a hundred sacrifices for worship."

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। शम्पाकेनेह मुक्तेन गीतं शान्तिगतेन च॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old history of what was sung by Champaka who had acquired tranquility and liberation for himself.

sa: पुनः स मुदितोत्पत्य रावणः परिषस्वजे। स भ्रात्रा संपरिष्वक्को यथावच्चाभिनन्दितः॥
en: Thereat, delighted, Ravana, springing up, again embraced (his brother). And embraced (by his brother), and duly greeted by him, that brother (of Ravana).

sa: दुर्योधनो हि समरे सहसैन्यः सहानुजः। निहतः क्षत्रधर्मेऽस्मिन् दुरात्मा कुलपांसनः॥
en: The wicked Duryodhana, the most infamous of his family has, with all his soldiers and his brothers, died in battle, performing Kshatriya duties.

sa: किमिदं द्यूतकामेन मया कृतमबुद्धिना। आदाय कृष्णां चरता वने मृगगणायुते॥
en: Having been addicted to dice what have I done foolishly. I am with Krishna (Draupadi) wandering in the forest full of wild animals!

sa: एवं ब्रुवन्महाराज महात्मा स महामतिः। महेष्वासैर्वतो राजन् महेष्वासो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Having thus (spoken, O mighty monarch, that illustrious site of generous intellect, that fierce bowmen, stood, king, being surrounded by many excellent car-warriors.

sa: उत्थानेनामृतं लब्धमुत्थानेनासुरा हताः। उत्थानेन महन्द्रेण श्रेष्ठ्यं प्राप्तं दिवीह च॥
en: By exertion the ambrosia was obtained; by exertion the Asuras were killed; by exertion Indra himself acquired sovereignty in heaven and on earth.

sa: चन्द्रकेतोश्च मल्लस्य मल्लभूम्यां निवेशिता। चन्द्रकान्तेति विख्याता दिव्या स्वर्गपुरी यथा॥
en: And in the country of Malaya he reared a city for Candraketu, named Candrakāntā highly picturesque and like to the city of celestials.

sa: ते स्मरन्तश्च संग्रामे चरिष्यन्ति च रुद्रवत्। लोहिताक्षो गुडाकेशो नारायणसहायवान्॥
en: Remembering these they will wander about in the battle like Rudra. Regarding Gudakesha (curling hair) of copper eyes having Narayana for his ally,

sa: नारायणपरो भूत्वा नारायणजपं जपन्। तस्यैव च प्रसादेन पुनरेवोत्थितस्तु सः॥
en: Ever devoted to Narayana, and ever reciting sacred Mantras having Narayana for their god, he once more ascended to heaven through Narayana's favour.

sa: ततो देवासुराः सर्वे ममन्थू रघुनन्दन। प्रविवेशाथ पातालं मन्थानः पर्वतोत्तमः॥
en: And then, O descendant of Raghu, as the celestials resumed the churning, that foremost of hills serving the cord, entered the subterranean regions.

sa: उवाच भीमसेनं स पितरं भीमविक्रमम्। स्मृतोऽस्मि भवता शीघ्रं शुश्रूषुरहमागतः॥
en: He then thus spoke to his greatly powerful father Bhimasena, "Having been remembered by you. I have speedily come here to serve you.

sa: देवान् रजस्तमश्चैव समाविविशतुस्तदा॥ वसुधा संचकम्पे च नभश्च विचचाल ह।
en: The quality of Darkness and Ignorance possessed the gods. The Earth shook. The vault of the sky seemed to divide in two parts.

sa: तेषु भासुरदेहेषु पुण्याभिजनकर्मसु। समागतेषु देवेषु व्यगमत् तत् तमो नृप॥
en: Upon the coming of those celestials of resplendent bodies and sanctified and noble deeds, the darkness that had covered that region immediately disappeared.

sa: एतदिच्छामि तत्त्वेन ज्ञातुं भार्गवसत्तम। विपर्यस्तं यथा नाम कुवलाश्वस्य धीमतः॥
en: O best of the Bhrigu race, I desire to know in detail why the name of the highly intelligent Kuvalashva underwent a change.

sa: सान्त्वयामास नारीश्च हतवीरा हतेश्वराः। विपुलैरर्थदानैः स तदा पाण्डुसुतो नृपः॥
en: The Pandava king then consoled those women, who had lost their heroic husbands and sons in the battle, with profuse gifts of wealth.
